We introduce SteerAct, a few-shot temporal steering framework that uses a shared temporal descriptor of sparse-feature dynamics for offline feature selection and online control. A pretrained sparse autoencoder provides candidate features, and our temporal descriptor summarizes the distribution of local activation-order patterns for each feature, enabling comparisons across rollouts without requiring timestep alignment. Before steering begins (offline), we use successful and failed reference rollouts to select a single task-specific feature whose temporal descriptors best distinguish the two outcomes and construct its reference banks. During each new execution (online), we compare the feature's evolving temporal descriptor with these references to determine when to intervene and how strongly to increase or decrease its activation via a steering coefficient. Using only 24 outcome-labeled rollouts per task, SteerAct improves task success by approximately 10% relative to unsteered models in evaluations spanning $π_{0.5}$, Fast-WAM, RoboTwin 2.0, DexJoCo, and real-world manipulation, without updating action-model weights. Code and demos are available at: https://steeract.github.io/.
tldr: SteerAct is a few-shot temporal steering framework that improves pretrained robot action models at test time by selecting sparse features from a sparse autoencoder and using temporal descriptors to dynamically control feature activation, boosting task success without modifying weights.
tldr_zh: SteerAct 是一种少样本时间引导框架，通过稀疏自编码器选择特征并利用时间描述符动态控制特征激活，在不修改权重的情况下提升预训练机器人动作模型的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 改进预训练机器人动作模型在测试时仅凭少量轨迹样本的表现仍然具有挑战性。激活引导提供了一种轻量级方法，通过修改特征激活值而保持模型权重不变。然而，有效的引导需要识别要修改哪些特征，并确定修改的时机和强度。我们提出了SteerAct，一种少样本时间引导框架，利用稀疏特征动态的共享时间描述符进行离线特征选择和在线控制。预训练的稀疏自编码器提供候选特征，我们的时间描述符总结了每个特征的局部激活顺序模式分布，从而无需时间步对齐即可跨轨迹进行比较。在引导开始之前（离线阶段），我们使用成功和失败的参考轨迹来选择单个任务特定特征，其时间描述符最能区分两种结果，并构建其参考库。在每次新执行过程中（在线阶段），我们将该特征随时间演变的时间描述符与这些参考进行比较，以确定何时干预以及通过引导系数以多大强度增加或减少其激活值。仅使用每项任务24条带结果标签的轨迹，SteerAct在涵盖$π_{0.5}$、Fast-WAM、RoboTwin 2.0、DexJoCo以及真实世界操作的评估中，相较于未引导模型将任务成功率相对提升了约10%，且无需更新动作模型权重。代码和演示可在以下网址获取：https://steeract.github.io/。

title: Humanoid SRL: Augmenting Humanoids with Supernumerary Limbs for Coordinated Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid robots are envisioned to perform diverse human-level tasks through their anthropomorphic morphology. Their dual-arm configuration enables a broad range of everyday actions. Yet, as in humans, this morphology can constrain loco-manipulation when both arms are occupied or additional contacts are required beyond their reach. Supernumerary robotic limbs (SRLs) offer a way to extend these capabilities, but their integration requires the added limb to be coordinated with whole-body motion and balance. In this study, we develop and integrate a supernumerary arm into a humanoid platform to investigate how morphological augmentation reshapes its feasible action space. Through quantitative analysis and hardware experiments across two configurations, we show how the additional limb expands whole-body interaction capabilities by enabling manipulation and support to be coordinated beyond the constraints of the native dual-arm configuration. To control this augmented morphology, we leverage model-based trajectory optimization (TO) to generate dynamically feasible motions for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) controllers. The controllers are trained in simulation and transferred to hardware in a zero-shot manner, enabling coordinated whole-body skills for contact-rich tri-arm loco-manipulation. We further show vision-guided autonomous execution on selected tasks using diffusion policies trained from hardware demonstrations. Our findings suggest that humanoid morphology need not be restricted to human-like forms, but can be reimagined as an extensible design space for robotic augmentation.
tldr: This paper integrates a supernumerary robotic limb into a humanoid robot, using model-based trajectory optimization and reinforcement learning to enable coordinated tri-arm loco-manipulation, with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and vision-guided autonomous execution.
tldr_zh: 本文将一个超冗余机械臂集成到人形机器人上，利用基于模型的轨迹优化和强化学习实现协调的三臂移动操作，并实现了零样本仿真到实物的迁移以及视觉引导的自主执行。
summary_zh: 人形机器人被设想通过其拟人形态执行多样化的类人任务。其双臂配置能够支持广泛的日常操作。然而，与人类相似，这种形态在双臂均被占用或需要超出手臂触及范围之外的额外接触时，可能限制移动操作能力。超 numerary 机器人肢体（SRLs）为扩展这些能力提供了一种途径，但其集成要求附加肢体与全身运动和平衡相协调。在本研究中，我们开发并将一条超 numerary 手臂集成到人形机器人平台中，以探究形态增强如何重塑其可行动作空间。通过两种配置下的定量分析和硬件实验，我们展示了附加肢体如何通过使操作与支撑在原生双臂配置约束之外得以协调，从而扩展全身交互能力。为控制这种增强形态，我们利用基于模型的轨迹优化（TO）生成动态可行的运动，用于目标条件强化学习（RL）控制器。这些控制器在仿真中训练，并以零样本方式迁移至硬件，实现了接触丰富的三臂移动操作所需的协调全身技能。我们进一步展示了基于硬件演示训练的扩散策略在选定任务上的视觉引导自主执行。我们的研究结果表明，人形机器人形态不必局限于类人形式，而可以被重新构想为机器人增强的可扩展设计空间。

title: Vector-Quantized World Model: Latent Feedback Motion Planning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach. In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors. Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities. We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably. Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.
tldr: This paper introduces VQ-WM, a latent feedback motion planning framework combining discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control for robot manipulation, achieving 100% success on physical Tower of Hanoi and outperforming world models on simulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VQ-WM，一种结合离散长时程搜索与连续视觉反馈控制的潜在反馈运动规划框架，在物理汉诺塔任务中实现100%成功率，并在仿真基准上优于现有世界模型。
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型在机器人规划中展现出巨大潜力，然而，由于预测误差的累积、搜索空间的庞大以及底层控制器难以可靠达成的潜在规划，长时程操作仍然面临挑战。在本研究中，我们引入了向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM），一种潜在反馈运动规划框架，该框架将离散长时程搜索与连续视觉反馈控制相结合：一个离散潜在预测器对向量量化潜在状态之间的转换进行建模，使规划器能够前瞻性地进行远距离搜索，并通过离散搜索找到到达目标的最短路径；同时，一个连续学习控制器通过视觉反馈顺序地到达规划状态，纠正偏差以减轻累积误差。与大多数使用欧氏距离的向量量化方法不同，我们采用了一种新颖的首次通过时间估计器作为准度量，使规划抽象与控制器能力对齐。我们在物理机器人操作的汉诺塔难题上进行了评估：尽管现有最先进的基础模型（如VLA、WAM）仅在其训练数据集包含解决方案轨迹时才能成功，我们的方法仅利用短片段数据便实现了100%的成功率，展示了其组合超出短演示轨迹的长时程解决方案并可靠执行的能力。此外，我们的解决方案在涵盖操作与运动控制的仿真基准测试中，比最强世界模型高出13.3至85.3个百分点，展现了一致的进步和新能力。

title: AQUAACT: A Joystick-Level Underwater Teleoperation Dataset and Closed-Loop Benchmark
summary: Underwater robots support a growing range of work, from inspecting offshore structures and pipelines to surveying reefs and accompanying divers. Most of these tasks, however, are still flown by hand by a pilot, which raises the question of whether they can be carried out autonomously instead. On land, vision-language-action (VLA) models already let robots carry out tasks autonomously from language instructions, which makes them a natural candidate for taking the pilot's place. Underwater, however, there is little data to train such models. We take inspiration from how these tasks are flown today: the pilot watches the camera image and steers with a joystick, whose commands the flight controller turns into motion. We therefore record the pilots and introduce AQUAACT, to our knowledge the first publicly available language-annotated underwater dataset pairing camera images with human joystick commands. It comprises 1.9 hours of real-world and 17.9 hours of simulated demonstrations, both flown by human pilots, together with the vehicle's inertial measurements. Experiments with AQUAACT show that its simulated demonstrations transfer to real data and greatly reduce the real demonstrations a policy needs. A closed-loop benchmark of seven policies in simulation, from imitation-learning baselines to VLA models, each trained with its default recipe, shows that these tasks remain far from solved: no policy completes more than a fifth of the episodes. Pretraining on land data gives large VLA models no advantage over small policies trained from scratch, a gap that land-trained models have yet to close underwater.
tldr: This paper introduces AQUAACT, the first publicly available language-annotated underwater teleoperation dataset with joystick commands, and presents a closed-loop benchmark showing that current VLA policies underperform, with land pretraining providing no advantage.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了首个公开的带语言注释的水下遥控操作数据集AQUAACT，并提供了一个闭环基准，表明当前VLA策略表现不佳，陆地预训练无优势。
summary_zh: 水下机器人的应用范围日益广泛，从检查海上结构和管道到勘察珊瑚礁以及协助潜水员等。然而，这些任务中的大多数仍由飞行员手动操控完成，这引发了一个问题：这些任务是否能够自主执行？在陆地上，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已经能够让机器人根据语言指令自主执行任务，因此它们自然成为取代飞行员的候选方案。但在水下环境中，可用于训练此类模型的数据十分有限。我们从这些任务当前的操控方式中汲取灵感：飞行员观察摄像头图像，并通过操纵杆进行操控，飞行控制器将操纵杆指令转化为运动。因此，我们记录了飞行员的操作过程，并推出了AQUAACT数据集——据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、将摄像头图像与人类操纵杆指令配对并带有语言标注的水下数据集。该数据集包含1.9小时的真实世界演示和17.9小时的模拟演示，均由人类飞行员操控完成，同时附带载体的惯性测量数据。基于AQUAACT的实验表明，模拟演示能够迁移至真实数据，并显著减少策略所需的真实演示数据量。我们在模拟环境中对七种策略进行了闭环基准测试，涵盖从模仿学习基线到VLA模型，每种策略均使用其默认配置进行训练。结果显示，这些任务远未得到解决：没有一种策略能够完成超过五分之一的测试回合。在陆地数据上的预训练并未给大型VLA模型带来相对于从零开始训练的小型策略的优势，这一差距表明陆地训练模型在水下环境中尚未体现出其优势。

title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
summary: Bimanual manipulation with dexterous hands has attracted growing attention in research on robotic action models. However, few studies have developed benchmarks specifically tailored for dexterous manipulation, leaving the dexterous manipulation capabilities of existing models insufficiently characterized. In this paper, we present BiDex-100, a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that combines broad task coverage, multi-dimensional evaluation, and high-DoF hand embodiments. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 106 tasks organized along five capability axes: generalization, instruction following, limited demonstrations, long horizon, and memory. Each task is paired with an out-of-domain variant featuring controlled visual and spatial changes, allowing systematic assessment of robustness. In addition, the benchmark supports two embodiments and provides 8,080 success-validated teleoperated demonstrations, totaling 6.25 million frames. We evaluate seven recent Vision-Language-Action models under a unified protocol, establishing baselines for capability-specific performance, robustness, and data efficiency. The website is available at https://BiDex-100.github.io/BiDex-100/.
tldr: This paper introduces BiDex-100, a comprehensive simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation, comprising 106 tasks across five capability axes with out-of-domain variants, two embodiments, and 8,080 teleoperated demonstrations. It evaluates seven recent VLA models under a unified protocol, providing baselines for robustness and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BiDex-100，一个全面的双臂灵巧操作模拟基准，包含106个任务，涵盖五个能力轴，并提供两个本体和8080条遥操作演示。论文在统一协议下评估了七个最新的VLA模型，建立了鲁棒性和数据效率的基线。
summary_zh: 双手灵巧操作在机器人动作模型研究中日益受到关注。然而，目前专门针对灵巧操作设计的基准测试仍较为匮乏，导致现有模型的灵巧操作能力未能得到充分表征。为此，本文提出了BiDex-100——一个面向双手灵巧操作的仿真基准，兼具广泛任务覆盖、多维度评估和高自由度手部实体支持。具体而言，该基准包含106项任务，沿五条能力主线组织：泛化能力、指令遵循、少量演示、长时程任务和记忆能力。每项任务均配对了一个域外变体，引入受控的视觉与空间变化，从而系统评估鲁棒性。此外，该基准支持两种手部实体，并提供8,080条经成功率验证的遥操作演示，总计625万帧数据。我们在统一评估协议下对七个近期提出的视觉-语言-动作模型进行了评测，建立了面向能力特定表现、鲁棒性和数据效率的基线结果。项目网站：https://BiDex-100.github.io/BiDex-100/。

title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
summary: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.
tldr: This paper introduces EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset for open-world embodied navigation-planning with multi-level annotations, and proposes a training scheme that uses a video world model as a proxy environment for interactive RL post-training, improving generalization to out-of-distribution scenes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了EmbodiedWorld-200K，一个用于开放世界具身导航规划的大规模数据集，并提出了利用视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理进行交互式强化学习后训练的方案，提升了对分布外场景的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 构建能够在多样三维世界中感知、推理并行动的具身智能体，是迈向通用人工智能的核心研究方向之一。然而，现有大多数工作仍局限于单一场景中的特定任务，且对新环境的泛化能力较差，面向开放世界条件的通用具身智能体仍未被充分探索。我们将此类智能体称为具身世界智能体（Embodied World Agents, EWAs），其关键特征在于能够理解多样化视觉环境，并在开放世界条件下执行通用动作。为推进EWA研究，我们聚焦于开放世界具身导航规划任务，并发布了EmbodiedWorld-200K——一个包含超过20万个样本的大规模数据集，覆盖多种场景。每个样本配有从低层相机运动轨迹到高层语义指令的多层级标注。该数据集还提供了统一的评测划分和任务特定指标，支持离线预训练及EWA的公平评估。除离线监督外，EWA的一个关键特征在于其与环境的交互能力；因此，仅依靠离线数据训练不足以实现其对训练分布中未覆盖场景的泛化。然而，构建专用的真实交互环境往往代价高昂。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新型训练方案：采用视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，并在其中对EWA进行交互式强化学习（RL）后训练。实验结果表明，在EmbodiedWorld-200K上进行预训练显著提升了EWA的开放世界具身规划能力；进一步在世界模型内进行RL后训练，在分布外场景上取得了明显增益。数据集、基线模型权重及训练与评测代码已开源，获取地址为：https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/。

title: Real-Time Radar Semantic and Panoptic Scene Understanding
summary: Robust scene understanding under varying environmental conditions is essential for safe autonomous driving. While cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather and poor lighting, Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) spinning radar provides dependable 360° perception at extended ranges with minimal compute cost. However, real-time FMCW radar scene understanding is challenging due to complex signal returns, limited temporal resolution, and scarce annotated datasets. We introduce StreamRPS, a novel framework for streaming FMCW radar panoptic segmentation, comprising an automated label-generation pipeline via LiDAR scene completion and a real-time streaming network for semantic and panoptic segmentation. Our encoder-decoder streaming architecture comprises a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder and task-specific decoders for semantic or panoptic prediction. Our encoder introduces a stem to capture range-dependent signatures, anisotropic patch embeddings to preserve angular resolution, and axial polar attention to separately model the periodic azimuth and bounded range axes. We further introduce azimuth roll rotation augmentation to simulate ego-vehicle rotation during training. Comprehensive experiments on the SAX and BOREAS datasets validate both our auto-labeling methodology and streaming segmentation network against established baselines. We outperform the strongest baseline by at least 1.4pp while processing sectors at over 400 FPS in a 4-sector streaming setting. We additionally provide manual annotations for 100 SAX radar scans, enabling independent evaluation of the entire framework.
tldr: StreamRPS introduces a real-time streaming FMCW radar panoptic segmentation framework for autonomous driving, featuring an automated LiDAR-based label generation pipeline and a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder, achieving over 400 FPS processing.
tldr_zh: StreamRPS 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的实时流式 FMCW 雷达全景分割框架，具有基于 LiDAR 的自动标签生成流程和雷达专用分层 Transformer 编码器，处理速度超过 400 FPS。
summary_zh: 在不同环境条件下实现鲁棒的场景理解对于安全自动驾驶至关重要。尽管摄像头和激光雷达在恶劣天气和光照不足条件下性能会下降，但调频连续波（FMCW）旋转雷达能够在扩展探测范围内以极低的计算成本提供可靠的360°感知。然而，由于复杂的信号回波、有限的时间分辨率以及稀缺的标注数据集，实时FMCW雷达场景理解面临诸多挑战。我们提出StreamRPS，一种用于流式FMCW雷达全景分割的新型框架，包含通过激光雷达场景补全实现的自动化标签生成流水线，以及用于语义分割和全景分割的实时流式网络。我们的编码器-解码器流式架构包含一个面向雷达的层级式Transformer编码器，以及用于语义或全景预测的任务特定解码器。我们的编码器引入了一个主干模块以捕获距离相关的信号特征，使用各向异性分块嵌入以保持角分辨率，并采用轴向极坐标注意力分别建模周期性方位角和有界距离轴。我们进一步引入了方位角滚动旋转增强，以在训练过程中模拟自车旋转。在SAX和BOREAS数据集上的综合实验验证了我们提出的自动标注方法和流式分割网络相较已有基线的优越性。在4扇区流式设置下，我们以超过400 FPS的处理速度，比最强基线至少高出1.4个百分点。此外，我们提供了100个SAX雷达扫描的人工标注，支持对整个框架进行独立评估。

title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
summary: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.
tldr: The paper introduces Stateful Harness, a framework that separates rule-based world state evolution from video rendering to enable stateful, rule-governed interactions in video world models, and presents WorldState-Bench for evaluating rule compliance. It demonstrates that explicitly executing rules before generating pixels significantly improves compliance for hidden-state scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Stateful Harness框架，将基于规则的世界状态演化与视频渲染分离，以支持具有隐藏状态的规则化交互，并构建WorldState-Bench基准进行评估，结果表明显式执行规则后再生成像素能显著提高规则遵循率。
summary_zh: 现有的世界模型可以从单张图像生成动作条件视频。其中许多模型聚焦于相机运动，使用户能够探索生成的场景。然而，仅靠导航并不能确保当动作的结果依赖于当前帧中不可见的状态时，该动作遵循持久规则。我们提出了“有状态驾驭框架（Stateful Harness）”，该框架将世界演化与视频渲染分离，以支持有状态且受规则约束的交互。该框架在指定规则下维护不断演化的世界状态，使用冻结的视频模型渲染每个结果事件，并利用生成的片段更新下一轮的世界状态。在每一轮中，该框架解析用户选择的动作，并将产生的事件编译为指令，同时来自可编辑3D场景的预览片段提供空间和相机引导。为了评估规则遵从性，我们构建了WorldState-Bench基准，包含50对反事实孪生样本，每对样本共享初始帧和动作，但隐藏状态和预期结果不同。在仅规则提示下，11个评估的视频后端中最佳模型在32%的样本对中同时生成了两种情况下所需的结局。对于MiniMax-H3，明确指定所需结局将该比例从32%提升至64%，而完整框架在相同冻结模型下达到了92%。这些结果支持在涉及隐藏状态的世界交互中将规则执行与视频渲染分离的做法。

title: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.
tldr: PrismWAM decouples semantic and physical state representations in World Action Models, using a Semantic Planning → Physical Rollout → Executable Action pipeline that predicts goal images and depth-space evolution for robotic manipulation, achieving strong performance in simulation and the real world without embodied action pretraining.
tldr_zh: PrismWAM 在世界动作模型中解耦语义与物理状态表示，通过语义规划→物理推演→可执行动作的流程，预测目标图像和深度空间演化以完成机器人操作，在仿真和真实世界中均表现优异，且无需具身动作预训练。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通常通过预训练视频模型的潜在嵌入来表示世界，这些嵌入将世界的异质方面纠缠在一起，从外观（如纹理和颜色）到物理配置（如占用和姿态）均包含在内。这引出了一个尚未充分探索的问题：$\textbf{世界动作模型的状态应由什么构成？}$我们认为，世界状态应将世界的外观与世界在动作下的演化方式分离开来：前者捕获语义上下文，而后者受物理状态支配。为此，我们提出$\textbf{PrismWAM}$，它在联合建模状态与动作的同时，将物理与语义解耦。PrismWAM将具身任务分解为$\mathrm{语义规划}\rightarrow\mathrm{物理推演}\rightarrow\mathrm{可执行动作}$的流程：仅给定初始RGB观测，语义规划学习预测最终目标图像，而物理推演在深度空间中预测朝向该目标的细粒度演化过程；随后从深度推演中生成可执行动作。在无需任何具身动作预训练或额外数据增强的情况下，PrismWAM在仿真和现实世界中均取得了优异的操作性能。值得注意的是，PrismWAM甚至超越了广泛采用大规模具身动作预训练的模型（如OpenWAM-$\alpha$）。更广泛地，我们重新定义了世界动作模型，从建模世界的外观转向建模世界对动作的响应，为基于占用、光流、触觉感知、本体感觉等构建以动作中心的世界模型铺平了道路。

title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
summary: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.
tldr: This paper proposes Fréchet Forcing, a fine-tuning method for streaming video world models that prevents long-horizon rollout drift by anchoring on real-data statistics (context fidelity and reality matching) without requiring a teacher model or long videos, enabling stable action-conditioned rollouts beyond 4000 frames.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 Fréchet Forcing 微调方法，通过基于真实数据统计的锚定（上下文保真度和现实匹配）来防止流式视频世界模型的长时程 rollout 漂移，无需教师模型或长视频，即可实现超过 4000 帧的稳定动作条件 rollout。
summary_zh: 流式视频世界模型逐块生成未来帧，其生成条件依赖于自身过往输出及一系列动作输入。由于在短片段上训练，一旦生成长度超出训练范围，预测误差会重新进入上下文并不断累积，导致模型发散。常见的解决方法是使用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）让模型在自身生成结果上训练。对于动作条件的视频世界模型，教师模型成为瓶颈：外部视频模型不感知动作，而模型自身的预训练网络又以与学生模型相同的方式发散。我们观察到，长的生成结果无需完全匹配教师模型，只要它能作为其所在场景的合理延续并遵循指令动作即可。真实性和场景保真度可通过真实数据统计量来衡量，这些统计量对任意长度均有效，而动作跟随能力则由模型的条件生成损失来保持。为此，我们提出Fréchet Forcing方法，在三个约束下同时对视频世界模型及其部署时使用的多步采样器进行微调。生成锚定（Generative anchoring）在基于真实数据结尾的自生成历史之后施加流匹配损失。上下文保真度（Context fidelity）通过计算自由生成过程中以各片段真实帧为中心的长序列潜变量统计量之间的Fréchet距离（FD），保证每次生成都忠实于其场景。真实感匹配（Reality matching）通过计算生成帧与真实帧在冻结感知空间中的Fréchet距离，确保生成的帧保持真实。由于这三个目标均来自短的真实片段，无需将生成结果与长记录未来进行比较，因此训练过程无需教师模型、无需在线判别器、也无需长视频。我们在预先训练于253帧片段的MiniWorld-1B模型上进行微调，在381帧片段上至多使用36个GPU小时，即可使生成结果在超过4,000帧后仍保持稳定，并且在机器人操作和摄像头控制的探索场景中都能持续遵循动作指令。

title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
summary: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).
tldr: This monograph aims to define the emerging field of Physical AI, unifying concepts from robotics, control, learning, and world models, and outlines its technical landscape, methodologies, applications, and challenges, distinguishing it from related fields and proposing a path toward Physical AGI. It provides a broad survey and framework for physical AI rather than presenting a single novel technical contribution.
tldr_zh: 这本专著旨在定义新兴的物理AI领域，融合机器人学、控制、学习和世界模型的概念，并概述其技术版图、方法、应用和挑战，将其与相关领域区分开来，并提出了通往物理AGI的路径。它提供了对物理AI的广泛概述和框架，而非单一的新技术贡献。
summary_zh: 近年来，物理人工智能（physical AI）发展迅速，受到学术界和工业界的广泛关注。然而，该领域在定义、技术体系及核心挑战等方面尚未达成共识。为弥补这一空白，本专著旨在界定物理人工智能，呈现其技术体系，并深入探讨各关键技术子领域，从而建立一个统一的物理人工智能框架：即在真实世界约束下，通过持续反馈感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统。此外，本专著将物理人工智能与传统数字人工智能、具身人工智能、信息物理系统及数字孪生进行区分，并在物理、控制、认知、学习与推理等方面奠定其理论基础。本专著综述了多模态感知、物理数据与仿真、世界模型、具身基础模型、运动控制系统、多智能体协同以及软硬件协同设计等关键方法。同时，考察了其在机器人技术、制造业、基础设施、科学实验和自主服务中的应用。特别关注从仿真到现实迁移、可靠性、实时执行、评估、安全性、治理及长期部署等问题。通过将感知、预测、决策、行动和适应闭环连接，本专著明确了从狭义自动化向更具泛化能力的物理人工智能，并最终迈向物理人工通用智能所需的技术挑战与研究方向。

title: Bio-inspired Thrust-Assisted Trotting on a legged-Aerial Robot via Real-Time QP-MPC
summary: This paper presents the hardware implementation of a quadratic program-based controller on Harpy: thruster-assisted bipedal robot to perform thruster-assisted trotting. This is inspired by wing-assisted locomotion observed in birds such as the chukar partridge, which employ thrust vectoring to manipulate the ground reaction force. The proposed controller formulates the thruster-assisted spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics as a condensed QP-based model predictive control problem, enabling simultaneous regulation of ground contact force and active thrust vectoring at 500 Hz. A decoupled control architecture is used, where the robot's sagittal dynamics are controlled using QP-MPC while the frontal dynamics is regulated using a cascade orientation stabilization controller. Two experiments were conducted with different forward reference velocities of 0 m/s and 0.1 m/s. While the instantaneous velocity oscillates, the mean velocities can track their respective reference. Additionally, joint tracking error remains within 1 deg while tracking the desired leg length given by the leg trajectory controller and desired swing trajectory given by Raibert's heuristic. The QP-MPC problem is consistently solved with 0.18ms, which is well within the 2ms computation budget while satisfying the GRF friction cone constraint.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time QP-MPC controller for thruster-assisted trotting on a bipedal legged-aerial robot, demonstrating simultaneous ground contact force and thrust vectoring regulation at 500 Hz with accurate velocity tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腿-空中两栖机器人扑翼辅助小跑的实时QP-MPC控制器，在500Hz下同时调节地面接触力和推力矢量，实现了精确的速度跟踪。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了在Harpy——一款推力辅助双足机器人上实现的基于二次规划的控制器硬件，用于执行推力辅助小跑步态。该研究的灵感来源于鸟类（如石鸡）中观察到的翼助 locomotion 现象，它们利用推力矢量控制来调节地面反作用力。所提出的控制器将推力辅助弹簧负载倒立摆动力学建模为基于二次规划（QP）的紧凑型模型预测控制问题，从而能够在500 Hz的频率下同时调节地面接触力和主动推力矢量。控制架构采用解耦方式，其中机器人矢状面动力学由QP-MPC控制，而额状面动力学则由级联姿态稳定控制器进行调节。实验分别在0 m/s和0.1 m/s两种前向参考速度下进行。尽管瞬时速度存在波动，但平均速度能够跟踪各自的参考值。此外，在跟踪腿部轨迹控制器给定的期望腿长以及Raibert启发式给定的期望摆动轨迹时，关节跟踪误差保持在1度以内。QP-MPC问题的求解时间稳定在0.18 ms，远低于2 ms的计算预算，同时满足地面反作用力摩擦锥约束。

title: ACE-Brain-0.6: Scaling Spatial Grounding for Physical Foundation Models
summary: General-purpose multimodal models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, demonstrate broad capabilities in embodied manipulation. Our analysis indicates that this generality is accompanied by strong spatial perception, as Astra can determine where to interact with task-relevant entities amid visual distractors. Because spatial perception connects high-level reasoning to the physical scene, we investigate scaling visual grounding to strengthen the perceptual foundation of general embodied operation. We develop a unified data pipeline that combines robot manipulation recordings with complementary visual data from diverse sources. After automatically annotating the robot recordings, the pipeline converts the collected data into verifiable grounding supervision. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on approximately 1.5 million samples produced by this pipeline yields ACE-Brain-0.6. The model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on four of seven public grounding benchmarks, with an overall average score of 75.41 compared with Astra's 73.68. Under a fixed Qwen3.5-9B fine-tuning setup, aggregate grounding performance improves steadily as successive data releases expand the training collection to cover a broader range of grounding scenarios. These results show that scaling verifiable grounding supervision from diverse sources can strengthen the spatial perception of an open 9B model for general embodied operation.
tldr: ACE-Brain-0.6 is a 9B multimodal model fine-tuned on 1.5 million automatically annotated robot and diverse visual samples, aiming to scale spatial grounding to improve embodied manipulation performance, outperforming larger proprietary models on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ACE-Brain-0.6 是一个在 150 万自动标注的机器人和多样视觉样本上微调的 9B 多模态模型，旨在通过扩展空间接地来提升具身操作能力，在多个基准上优于更大的专有模型。
summary_zh: 通用型多模态模型，包括GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5，在具身操作领域展现出广泛的能力。我们的分析表明，这种通用性伴随着强大的空间感知能力，Astra能够在视觉干扰物中确定与任务相关实体的交互位置。由于空间感知将高层推理与物理场景相连接，我们研究了如何扩展视觉基础以强化通用具身操作的感知基础。我们开发了一套统一的数据流水线，将机器人操作记录与来自多种来源的互补视觉数据相结合。在自动标注机器人记录后，该流水线将收集到的数据转化为可验证的基础监督信号。利用该流水线生成的约150万个样本对Qwen3.5-9B进行微调，得到ACE-Brain-0.6模型。该模型在七个公开基础基准测试中的四个上超越了GPT-6 Astra，总体平均得分为75.41，而Astra为73.68。在固定的Qwen3.5-9B微调设置下，随着连续数据发布将训练集扩展到覆盖更广泛的基础场景，聚合基础性能稳步提升。这些结果表明，从多种来源扩展可验证的基础监督信号能够增强开放9B模型在通用具身操作中的空间感知能力。

title: Embodied Playground: A Long-Horizon Agentic Robotics Benchmark for Physical, Strategic, and Spatial Reasoning
summary: Foundation models offer a promising basis for robotic agents, but long-horizon tasks require them to sustain coherent reasoning and reliable physical execution across interdependent stages. We introduce Embodied Playground, a benchmark for evaluating how foundation-model agents coordinate physical, strategic, and spatial reasoning throughout such tasks. Agents must track task progress, satisfy intermediate constraints, and revise their plans using execution feedback as earlier actions shape subsequent decisions. The playground comprises 410 task environments spanning basic manipulation, sequential puzzles, and multi-stage household activities, with variations in planning depth, geometric constraints, and physical execution demands. We curate EP-100, a representative selection of 100 tasks across five suites and 16 task types, together with the EP-Easy and EP-Hard difficulty splits and the compact EP-20 selection. A shared protocol specifies observation and tool access, resource budgets, repeated trials, and independent checks of goal completion, task-rule compliance, and physical validity. Embodied Playground provides a unified framework for studying whether foundation-model agents can sustain effective reasoning and action over extended task horizons. https://winniechen2002.github.io/Agent-bench-website/
tldr: Embodied Playground introduces a benchmark of 410 long-horizon task environments for evaluating foundation-model agents' physical, strategic, and spatial reasoning, with a curated subset EP-100 and a unified evaluation protocol.
tldr_zh: Embodied Playground 提出了一个包含410个长时程任务环境的基准，用于评估基础模型智能体的物理、策略和空间推理能力，并提供了精选子集EP-100和统一的评估协议。
summary_zh: 基础模型为机器人智能体提供了有前景的基础，但长时程任务要求它们在相互依赖的各个阶段中保持连贯推理与可靠的物理执行。我们引入具身游乐场（Embodied Playground），这是一个评估基础模型智能体在此类任务中协调物理推理、策略推理与空间推理能力的基准。智能体必须跟踪任务进度、满足中间约束，并利用执行反馈修订自身计划，因为先前的行动会影响后续决策。该游乐场包含410个任务环境，涵盖基础操作、序列谜题和多阶段家务活动，并在规划深度、几何约束和物理执行需求上有所区分。我们精心构建了EP-100，这是从五个任务套件和16种任务类型中选取的100个代表性任务子集，同时提供EP-Easy和EP-Hard难度划分，以及精简的EP-20子集。统一协议规定了观察与工具访问方式、资源预算、重复试验，以及对目标完成、任务规则遵守和物理有效性进行独立检查的标准。具身游乐场为研究基础模型智能体能否在扩展任务时程中维持有效推理与行动提供了一个统一框架。https://winniechen2002.github.io/Agent-bench-website/

title: Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing
summary: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.
tldr: This paper introduces Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that pretrains a world model on heterogeneous simulation data and adapts it with limited real-world interaction for autonomous racing, achieving rapid few-shot adaptation on a real full-size race car.
tldr_zh: 本文提出先验信息适应（PIA），一种离线和在线结合的基于模型的强化学习框架，通过异构仿真数据预训练世界模型并用有限真实交互进行自适应，在真实全尺寸赛车上实现了快速少样本适应。
summary_zh: 摘要：强化学习能够学习高性能控制策略，但其对大量交互的依赖限制了其在数据采集成本高昂且失败不安全物理系统上的部署。我们提出先验信息自适应（PIA），一种基于模型的离线到在线强化学习框架，利用结构化仿真先验实现快速自适应。PIA在异构低保真和高保真模拟轨迹上预训练世界模型，随后通过不确定性正则化规划，利用有限的目标域交互进行自适应。PIA并未依赖精确的仿真器进行策略迁移，而是将模拟轨迹视为有偏先验，在在线自适应过程中修正其残差不匹配。我们在自动驾驶竞速中，使用高保真仿真以及在真实全尺寸自动驾驶赛车上对PIA进行了评估。在仿真中，PIA在不同赛道和路面变化下的自适应速度快于强基线方法，实现了更低的单圈时间和更少的失败次数。在实车上，PIA实现了可靠的少样本自适应，且车载交互时间不到一小时。

title: VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation
summary:
Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence.
  We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.
tldr: VaDar proposes value disaggregation to train a single subgoal-independent policy for long-horizon tasks, showing competitive or better performance than goal-conditioned baselines and solving RoboCasa tasks.
tldr_zh: VaDar 通过价值分解训练一个无需子目标条件的策略，用于长时程任务，在 RoboCasa 中取得了优于目标条件基线的最新成果。
summary_zh:
长程任务对现代人工智能和机器人技术至关重要，但同时也对强化学习构成了挑战。历史上，一种流行的方法是将任务分解为子目标，并学习一个以子目标为条件的策略，以依次执行每个子任务。

我们提出了一种称为值分解（Value Disaggregation, VaDar）的替代方法，该方法训练一个单一的不依赖于子目标的策略，以最大化各子目标评论家值的线性组合。由于子目标信息仅在训练时所需，VaDar在策略部署期间无需进行可能成本高昂或繁琐的子目标选择。此外，通过细致的实验，我们证明VaDar（1）始终能与目标条件化等自然基线方法相媲美，且经常超越它们；（2）在具有非顺序目标结构和多优化目标的任务上表现出色。尤其值得一提的是，VaDar是首个在RoboCasa套件中解决具有挑战性的长程任务的算法，即便从行为克隆预训练且初始任务成功率近乎为零的策略出发也能实现。综合来看，VaDar的成功表明，子目标信息通过增强评论家学习的效率来有益于演员-评论家强化学习，而对策略进行目标条件化往往并非必要。

title: A Human-in-the-Loop Comparison of Proportional Control and Adaptive Gravity Compensation in Elbow EMG-Driven Exoskeletons
summary: Electromyography (EMG)-driven control enables wearable robots to assist users based on their neuromuscular activity. Upper-limb exoskeletons typically rely on proportional myoelectric control (PMC), which amplifies user effort but may compromise stability at high assistance levels. EMG-driven adaptive gravity compensation (AGC) offers a promising alternative, counterbalancing gravitational torques while continuously adapting to neuromuscular activity. However, these approaches have not been systematically compared in a human-in-the-loop setting. This study evaluates five control algorithms: two PMC strategies at different assistance levels, a purely integral AGC (AGC-PI), a kinematics- and acceleration-aware model-based (MB) AGC (AGC-AW), and a novel MB AGC approach based on Recursive Least Squares (AGC-RLS) for online payload estimation. Fourteen healthy participants performed target-reaching tasks using an active elbow exoskeleton under 0 kg and 2 kg loading conditions. Performance metrics included muscular activity, movement accuracy, task efficiency, and subjective workload. PMC exhibited a trade-off between physical effort and task performance: low assistance levels required greater physical effort under load, whereas high gains impaired task execution. AGC-PI reduced agonist activity but induced antagonist activation. In contrast, both model-based AGC approaches effectively compensated for external payloads, reducing physical and cognitive demands while improving movement accuracy and completion time.
tldr: This paper presents a human-in-the-loop comparison of proportional myoelectric control and adaptive gravity compensation methods for elbow EMG-driven exoskeletons, showing that model-based adaptive gravity compensation reduces physical/cognitive demands and improves task performance.
tldr_zh: 本文对人体在环肘部肌电驱动外骨骼的比例肌电控制与自适应重力补偿方法进行了比较，结果表明基于模型的自适应重力补偿能降低身心负担并提高任务表现。
summary_zh: 肌电（EMG）驱动的控制方式使可穿戴机器人能够根据用户的神经肌肉活动提供辅助。上肢外骨骼通常依赖比例肌电控制（PMC），该方式虽可放大用户用力，但在高辅助水平下可能损害系统稳定性。肌电驱动的自适应重力补偿（AGC）提供了一种有前景的替代方案，在持续适应神经肌肉活动的同时抵消重力矩。然而，这些方法尚未在人在环路（human-in-the-loop）条件下进行系统比较。本研究评估了五种控制算法：两种不同辅助水平下的PMC策略、一种纯积分式AGC（AGC-PI）、一种融合运动学与加速度信息的基于模型（MB）的AGC（AGC-AW），以及一种基于递推最小二乘（RLS）的新型MB AGC方法（AGC-RLS），用于在线负载估计。十四名健康受试者在0 kg和2 kg负载条件下，使用主动式肘部外骨骼执行目标到达任务。性能指标包括肌肉活动、运动精度、任务效率及主观负荷。结果表明，PMC在体力消耗与任务表现之间存在权衡：低辅助水平在负载条件下需要更大的体力投入，而高增益则损害任务执行效果。AGC-PI降低了主动肌活动，但引发了拮抗肌激活。相比之下，两种基于模型的AGC方法均能有效补偿外部负载，在降低体力和认知需求的同时，提高了运动精度并缩短了任务完成时间。

title: RoboMMT: Learning Stable Tracking of Modulated Expressive and Interactive Robot Motion
summary: Expressive robot motion can improve naturalness, effectiveness, and perceived likability in human-robot interaction. When deployed on dynamically unstable platforms, however, reactive execution of expressive body motion may bring the robot to its stability limits, especially when expressivity is decoupled from physical control. In this paper, we present RoboMMT (Robot Modulated Motion Tracking), a modular control architecture that couples parameterized expressive motion synthesis, physics-based character control, and reactive adaptation to spatial interaction goals. Our approach trains a reference-conditioned tracking policy across a broad domain of expressivity, enabling it to faithfully realize the commanded motions while maintaining dynamic stability. Goal reactivity is achieved by training lightweight, task-specific interaction policies that modulate the reference generator's spatial goal-attraction point, with the stabilizing tracking policy kept in the loop. Evaluations on a quadruped and two humanoid robots show that the learned tracker remains stable and accurate across the entire modulation domain, whereas trackers trained without this coverage lose balance, tracking accuracy, or both. We show that layering closed-loop goal adaptation over this foundation enables interactive facing and pointing behaviors, while maintaining stable execution and comparable reference-tracking fidelity. The robot learns to proactively redistribute its weight and take corrective steps. Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated through real-robot experiments on a quadruped under heavy disturbances.
tldr: RoboMMT presents a modular control architecture that couples expressive motion synthesis with physics-based character control and reactive goal adaptation, enabling stable tracking on quadruped and humanoid robots with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: RoboMMT提出了一种模块化控制架构，将表达性动作合成与基于物理的角色控制及交互目标反应性适应相结合，在四足和人形机器人上实现了稳定跟踪，并具有零样本仿真到现实的迁移能力。
summary_zh: 表达型机器人运动能够提升人机交互中的自然度、有效性和感知喜好度。然而，当部署在动态不稳定的平台上时，表达性身体运动的反应式执行可能将机器人推向其稳定性极限，尤其是当表达性与物理控制解耦时。本文提出了RoboMMT（机器人调制运动跟踪），一种模块化控制架构，将参数化表达运动生成、基于物理的角色控制以及对空间交互目标的反应式适应相结合。该方法训练了一个覆盖广泛表达域的参考条件跟踪策略，使其能够在保持动态稳定性的同时忠实执行指令运动。目标反应性通过训练轻量级、任务特定的交互策略实现，这些策略调制参考生成器的空间目标吸引点，同时保持稳定跟踪策略处于闭环中。在四足机器人和两款人形机器人上的评估表明，所学跟踪器在整个调制域内保持稳定和准确，而未覆盖该域训练的跟踪器则会出现失稳、跟踪精度下降或两者兼有的问题。我们展示了在该基础上叠加闭环目标适应能够实现交互式朝向和指向行为，同时保持稳定执行和可比的参考跟踪保真度。机器人学会主动重新分配自身重量并采取修正步态。通过在实际四足机器人上施加强干扰的真实机器人实验，验证了零样本仿真到实物迁移的有效性。

title: ForagerSim: Evaluating Embodied Map-Based Reasoning in Large-Scale Dynamic Worlds
summary: Animals build cognitive maps of vast environments, use them to perform map-based navigation, and might even be reusing the same circuitry used in spatial reasoning for creating and using maps of arbitrary task-spaces. In contrast, current embodied AI systems either rely on hand-engineered mapping pipelines, which break in the presence of unmodeled dynamics and are restricted to metric space, or on learned policies that rarely form map-like representations at all. Developing architectures that could learn to build and use map-like representations as flexibly as animals is, however, difficult because few embodied AI benchmarks actually require map-based reasoning. To address this, we present ForagerSim --- an interdisciplinary research platform and simulation environment focused on embodied tasks that require map-based reasoning, with scenarios ranging from mobile-robot search and rescue to animal foraging in both complex mazes and vast, potentially infinite open areas. ForagerSim is highly modular and allows modifying independent axes of difficulty related to perception (abstract 2D sensing to full RGB or LiDAR), scale (room-scale to multi-km scale), topology (open-fields to complex mazes), dynamics (smoke, debris, sensorimotor failures and others) and tasks (from simple 2D coverage to foraging-inspired well-alternation tasks). We compare reinforcement learning baselines with a simple engineered robotics stack and a human player on 8 example worlds which show how different difficulty axes affect existing methods. Our results show that, when sensing is simplified to 2D, learned policies can perform multi-object search and well-alternation tasks surprisingly well in simple topologies, but they fall short of human performance in larger or more complex-topology environments where map-based baselines perform well, suggesting that map-based reasoning is the bottleneck in these scenarios.
tldr: ForagerSim is a simulation platform and benchmark for embodied map-based reasoning in large-scale dynamic worlds, showing that current RL policies struggle in complex topologies where map-based baselines excel.
tldr_zh: ForagerSim 是一个用于大规模动态世界中具身地图推理的模拟平台和基准，结果表明当前强化学习策略在复杂拓扑中表现不佳，而基于地图的基线方法表现良好。
summary_zh: 动物能够在广阔的环境中构建认知地图，利用这些地图进行基于地图的导航，甚至可能将空间推理所用的同一套神经回路，复用于创建和利用任意任务空间的“地图”。相比之下，当前的具身人工智能系统要么依赖手工设计的建图流程，这些流程在存在未建模动态时会失效，并且仅限于度量空间；要么依赖学习得到的策略，而这些策略几乎从不形成类似地图的表征。然而，开发能够像动物一样灵活地学习构建和使用类地图表征的架构十分困难，因为很少有具身人工智能基准测试真正需要基于地图的推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ForagerSim——一个跨学科研究平台与仿真环境，专注于需要基于地图推理的具身任务，其场景涵盖移动机器人搜索与救援，以及动物在复杂迷宫和广阔、甚至可能无限的开阔区域中的觅食行为。ForagerSim具有高度模块化的特点，允许独立调整与感知（从抽象二维感知到全RGB或LiDAR）、尺度（从房间尺度到多公里尺度）、拓扑（从开放场地到复杂迷宫）、动力学（烟雾、碎片、感觉运动故障等）以及任务（从简单二维覆盖到受觅食启发的交替井任务）相关的难度维度。我们在8个示例世界中，将强化学习基线方法与一套简单工程化机器人技术栈及人类玩家进行比较，展示了不同难度维度如何影响现有方法。我们的结果表明，当感知被简化为二维时，学习策略能够在简单拓扑中出人意料地很好地完成多目标搜索和交替井任务，但在更大或拓扑更复杂的环境中，它们则达不到人类的表现水平，而基于地图的基线与人类表现相当，表明在这些场景中基于地图的推理是瓶颈所在。

title: Robotic Photography System based on Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.
tldr: RoboPhoto-VLA introduces a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for autonomous robotic photography, using PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences, validated through real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: RoboPhoto-VLA 提出了一种用于自主机器人摄影的统一视觉-语言-动作框架，通过 PhotoCoT 进行结构化动作规划，并利用美学直接偏好优化使相机行为符合人类审美偏好，并通过真实世界实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 现代机器人摄影要求理解摄影意图、规划相机运动，并在复杂环境中生成具有美学价值的图像。我们提出了RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，联合建模感知、推理与相机控制，以实现自主机器人摄影。RoboPhoto-VLA集成了PhotoCoT用于结构化动作规划，以及美学直接偏好优化（ADPO），使相机行为与人类审美偏好对齐。为促进训练与评估，我们构建了OpenPhotography，一个包含语言引导演示的机器人摄影数据集。大量真实世界实验表明，RoboPhoto-VLA生成的图像更符合人类审美偏好，并能有效泛化到未见过的目标、视角、姿态及复杂摄影指令。

title: PhantomTac: Hijacking Robotic Tactile Systems with Deploy-and-forget Tags
summary: Tactile perception is crucial for precise robotic manipulation, providing an important foundation for dexterous, closed-loop force control. Among various tactile sensing techniques, magnetic tactile sensors stand out thanks to their fine-grained, three-dimensional force perception capability and strong robustness against visual occlusion. In this study, we discover a physical loophole called PhantomTac in magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can alter the magnetic field, thus spoofing the force interpreted by magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can stealthily deploy such an attack by simply attaching a thin (the thickness is around 0.5 mm), battery-free magnetic tag to the surface of an object. Hence, the attack tag can be easily concealed by a barcode sticker. Such an attack scheme is "deploy-and-forget" -- the attacker can deploy the tag and leave. When a robotic hand is picking up an object, it may severely damage the object. Specifically, spoofing the normal force can crush the object, whereas spoofing the shear force can lead to a loose grip, thus dropping the object. Compared with directly sabotaging the robotic hand, PhantomTac is much more concealed as the attacker does not need access to the device. We performed extensive reverse-engineering efforts to characterize the sensing mechanism of commercial-off-the-shelf tactile sensors and proposed a practical tag design. End-to-end evaluations conducted on real robots and robotic arms demonstrate that our attack can bypass existing anti-interference mechanisms and effectively hijack their closed-loop control processes, achieving an attack success rate exceeding 95% when the grasping-position offset is bounded within 8 mm. Finally, based on the limitations of existing anti-magnetic interference mechanisms, we propose a multimodal-consistency defense mechanism to mitigate such physical-layer security threats.
tldr: This paper uncovers a security vulnerability in magnetic tactile sensors used in robotic manipulation, showing that an attacker can spoof force readings by attaching a thin magnetic tag to objects, causing robots to crush or drop them, and proposes a defense mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文揭示了机器人操纵中磁触觉传感器的安全漏洞，攻击者可通过在物体上粘贴薄磁标签来伪造力读数，导致机器人压碎或掉落物体，并提出了一种防御机制。
summary_zh: 触觉感知对于精确的机器人操作至关重要，为灵巧的闭环力控制提供了重要基础。在各种触觉传感技术中，磁式触觉传感器因其细粒度的三维力感知能力和对视觉遮挡的强鲁棒性而脱颖而出。本研究中，我们发现了磁式触觉传感器中一种名为PhantomTac的物理漏洞。攻击者可以改变磁场，从而欺骗磁式触觉传感器所解读的力信息。攻击者只需在物体表面贴附一层薄型（厚度约0.5毫米）、无需电池的磁性标签，即可隐蔽地实施此类攻击。因此，该攻击标签可以轻松被条形码贴纸所掩盖。这种攻击方案是“部署即遗忘”式的——攻击者部署标签后即可离开。当机械手抓取物体时，可能会对物体造成严重损坏。具体而言，欺骗法向力可导致物体被压碎，而欺骗剪切力则会导致抓握不牢，从而使物体掉落。与直接破坏机械手相比，PhantomTac的隐蔽性更强，因为攻击者无需接触设备本身。我们进行了大量逆向工程工作，以表征商用现成触觉传感器的传感机制，并提出了一种实用的标签设计。在真实机器人和机械臂上进行的端到端评估表明，我们的攻击能够绕过现有的抗干扰机制，有效劫持其闭环控制过程，在抓取位置偏移不超过8毫米时，攻击成功率超过95%。最后，基于现有抗磁干扰机制的局限性，我们提出了一种多模态一致性防御机制，以缓解此类物理层安全威胁。

title: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection
summary: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) allows robots to learn new skills from human examples; however, many vision-based methods require large datasets and resource-intensive end-to-end training. This paper introduces a data-efficient LfD framework for humanoid robots that learns manipulation skills from compact, task-specific features instead of raw images. The proposed approach integrates layered visual preprocessing, Kinect-based human joint estimation, prompt-based object detection, and depth information to extract human motion features and three-dimensional object locations from demonstration videos. These features are used to train a temporal deep learning model that predicts robot joint-angle trajectories for execution. The framework is implemented on a NAO humanoid robot, evaluated quantitatively in simulation, and demonstrated on physical hardware. In simulation, the robot achieves a 78% success rate on a pick-and-place task using only 16 demonstrations, which increases to 86% when trained with 100 demonstrations. The framework also achieves a 71% success rate on a pushing task using eight demonstrations, highlighting its effectiveness for data-efficient humanoid skill acquisition.
tldr: This paper presents a data-efficient learning-from-demonstration framework for humanoid robots that extracts task-specific features from demonstrations using layered visual preprocessing, Kinect-based joint estimation, prompt-based object detection, and depth information, then trains a temporal deep learning model to predict joint-angle trajectories, achieving high success rates with few demonstrations on a NAO robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据高效的人形机器人示范学习框架，通过分层视觉预处理、Kinect关节估计、基于提示的目标检测和深度信息提取任务特征，训练时序深度学习模型预测关节角轨迹，在NAO机器人上以少量示范实现高成功率。
summary_zh: 从示范中学习（LfD）使机器人能够从人类示例中习得新技能；然而，许多基于视觉的方法需要大规模数据集和资源密集型的端到端训练。本文提出了一种面向人形机器人的数据高效LfD框架，该框架从紧凑的任务特定特征而非原始图像中学习操作技能。该方法整合了分层视觉预处理、基于Kinect的人体关节估计、基于提示的目标检测以及深度信息，从示范视频中提取人体运动特征和三维物体位置。这些特征用于训练一个时间深度学习模型，预测机器人执行时的关节角轨迹。该框架在NAO人形机器人上实现，并在仿真中进行了定量评估，同时在物理硬件上进行了演示。在仿真中，机器人仅使用16次示范便在一项抓取放置任务中实现了78%的成功率，当使用100次示范训练时，成功率提升至86%。该框架在一项推动任务中使用八次示范实现了71%的成功率，凸显了其在数据高效的人形技能获取方面的有效性。

title: A Spiking Ring-Attractor Architecture for Representation and Control of Revolute Robot Joints
summary: Robotic systems with revolute joints evolve on circular state spaces, yet most control architectures represent these states using Euclidean variables that ignore this underlying geometry. We propose a fully spiking neural control architecture in which ring attractors encode joint states, enforcing representations consistent with the topology of revolute systems. Homeostatic regulation computes goal-state mismatch directly over these distributed representations, and opponent gain-modulated populations convert this mismatch into controlled phase shifts of the activity bump, implementing set-point regulation as motion on the ring. We show that the bump dynamics follow an SO(2) geometry, and that gain asymmetries induce a signed phase velocity on the ring. To interface distributed activity with scalar regulation signals, we derive an analytic Fourier phase decoder and implement its signed components using push-pull spiking populations. For multi-joint systems, we demonstrate that local ring-based Fourier features compose into product representations that linearly decode SO(3) orientations through forward kinematics. Experiments in NEST validate the full SO(2) regulation mechanism and the spiking product-feature decoder for lift, pitch, and yaw. Robot experiments on a Tiago arm show that decoded ring dynamics generate joint velocity commands, producing directed motion with joint-dependent accuracy. Together, these results establish a neuromorphic control framework in which representation, regulation, and action are unified within a ring-attractor substrate aligned with the geometry of revolute systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a fully spiking neural control architecture using ring attractors to represent and control revolute robot joints, demonstrating set-point regulation and multi-joint composition in simulations and on a Tiago robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于环吸引子的全脉冲神经控制架构，用于表示和控制旋转机器人关节，并在仿真和Tiago机械臂上展示了设定点调节和多关节复合。
summary_zh: 具有转动关节的机器人系统在圆周状态空间上演化，然而大多数控制架构使用忽略这一底层几何结构的欧几里得变量来表示这些状态。我们提出了一种全脉冲神经控制架构，其中环吸引子编码关节状态，使表示与转动系统的拓扑结构保持一致。稳态调节直接在这些分布式表示上计算目标状态失配，而对抗性增益调制群体将该失配转换为活动凸起的受控相位偏移，从而将设定点调节实现为环上的运动。我们证明凸起动力学遵循SO(2)几何结构，并且增益不对称性在环上诱发有符号的相位速度。为了将分布式活动与标量调节信号对接，我们推导出解析傅里叶相位解码器，并使用推-拉脉冲群体实现其有符号分量。对于多关节系统，我们证明基于局部环的傅里叶特征可组合成乘积表示，通过正向运动学线性解码SO(3)姿态。在NEST中的实验验证了完整的SO(2)调节机制以及用于升降、俯仰和偏航的脉冲乘积特征解码器。在Tiago机械臂上的机器人实验表明，解码的环动力学生成关节速度指令，产生具有关节相关精度的定向运动。综合这些结果，我们建立了一个神经形态控制框架，其中表示、调节和动作在环吸引子基底中统一，并与转动系统的几何结构相一致。

title: SkateNav: Learning Energy-Efficient Navigation through Adaptive Skating on Passive-Wheel Quadrupedal Robots
summary: Passive-wheel quadrupedal robots offer energy-efficient locomotion through leg-driven propulsion and momentum-driven gliding. However, navigation requires coordinating steering with intermittent propulsion and adapting push-glide timing to task demands. Velocity-tracking objectives may suppress the speed variations inherent in skating, discouraging efficient gliding. To address these challenges, we propose SkateNav, a unified skating-navigation framework based on reinforcement learning. A time-budgeted goal-reaching objective allows the policy to jointly learn steering, propulsion, and their temporal allocation. An adaptive skating cycle structures gliding, pushing, and recovery, while frequency modulation at every control step adjusts phase durations to navigation demands. Simulation experiments demonstrate higher average success rates and lower cost of transport than the evaluated planner-controller baselines, with ablations confirming the contributions of cycle structure and frequency adaptation. Real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer from simulation to a passive-wheel Mini Cheetah across cluttered indoor spaces, slopes, and paved outdoor surfaces. Supplementary videos are available on the project page: https://ktw1404.github.io/SkateNav/
tldr: SkateNav introduces a reinforcement learning framework for energy-efficient navigation on passive-wheel quadrupedal robots, using adaptive skating cycles and frequency modulation to achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: SkateNav 提出了一种用于被动轮四足机器人节能导航的强化学习框架，通过自适应滑行周期和频率调制，实现了从仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 被动轮四足机器人通过腿部驱动推进和动量驱动的滑行实现高能效运动。然而，导航需要在间歇性推进中协调转向，并根据任务需求调整推滑时序。速度跟踪目标可能会抑制滑冰过程中固有的速度波动，从而阻碍高效滑行。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了SkateNav，一种基于强化学习的统一滑行导航框架。时间预算目标到达目标函数使策略能够联合学习转向、推进及其时间分配。自适应滑行周期结构化滑行、推进和恢复阶段，而每个控制步的频率调制则根据导航需求调整相位持续时间。仿真实验表明，与所评估的规划器-控制器基线相比，该方法实现了更高的平均成功率和更低的运输成本，消融实验证实了周期结构和频率自适应的贡献。真实世界实验展示了从仿真到被动轮Mini Cheetah的零样本迁移，覆盖杂乱室内空间、坡道和铺装室外地面。补充视频可在项目页面获取：https://ktw1404.github.io/SkateNav/

title: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
summary: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.
tldr: OV-PEAR is a three-stage RGB-D framework for zero-shot 6D pose-scale estimation and 3D reconstruction of unknown industrial objects, verified by multi-view observations and validated on real-robot connector assembly.
tldr_zh: OV-PEAR 是一个三阶段 RGB-D 框架，用于未知工业物体的零样本 6D 位姿-尺度估计和 3D 重建，通过多视图观测验证，并在真实机器人连接器装配中验证。
summary_zh: 精细工业机器人操作需要6D位姿、尺度以及一个可直接用于操作的三维模型。现有的工业位姿估计方法依赖于CAD模型、特定对象的训练数据或稳定的工作单元，限制了其在未见对象上的应用；零样本方法则受限于单视角遮挡、生成偏差和尺度不确定性。我们提出了OV-PEAR，一个面向未知工业对象三维重建与位姿-尺度估计的观测验证框架。其三级对象中心流水线如下：（1）分割RGB-D实例并生成对象级三维假设；（2）通过外观感知视图检索、显式尺度搜索和可见性敏感配准，将其锚定到机器人坐标系中；（3）将多视角RGB-D证据反投影到对象规范坐标系中，以验证体素占用、抑制幻觉，并生成可复用的可信对象模型。在BOP-Industrial基准上，OV-PEAR取得了0.657的平均AR，并在真实场景中提升了位姿及体素级几何一致性；真实机器人连接器装配任务实现了99.67%的抓取成功率和84.00%的装配成功率。模型库与位姿-尺度日志支持0.02毫秒/帧的短期对象级状态维护。

title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
summary: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.
tldr: This paper introduces a collective experience learning (CEL) paradigm for robot fleets, realized through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT) and a fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS), which improves policy success rates across real-world manipulation tasks without additional expert demonstrations or corrections.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人集群的集体经验学习（CEL）范式，通过失败引导的经验检索微调（FERT）和容错异步训练系统（FATS），在无需额外专家示范或纠正的情况下，提高了真实操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 在部署过程中产生的经验为机器人提供了通过从自身执行中学习来提高策略可靠性的机会。然而，通过人工纠正进行学习要求远程操作员监控执行过程并在策略失败时进行干预，随着机器人队伍规模的扩大，这一需求难以满足。我们引入了集体经验学习（CEL），这是一种学习范式，其中已部署的机器人共享其执行经验以改进共同策略。我们通过失败引导的经验检索微调（FERT）实现了CEL，该方法利用机器人执行中的失败情境从队伍共享的成功经验中检索相关轨迹片段，并以这些轨迹中的动作作为策略更新的监督信号，无需收集额外的专家示范或纠正动作。容错异步训练系统（FATS）在机器人队伍内部出现局部中断的情况下，协调经验收集、策略优化和策略分发。在五个真实世界操作任务中，所得到的策略在每项任务120次试验中，于未参与训练数据收集的机器人上评估，成功率达到了93.3%至99.2%。在每台机器人收集时间固定的条件下，更大的队伍提供更多经验，FERT在评估的规模范围内总体上实现了更高的成功率。在多阶段手机包装任务中，使用96台机器人进行学习将成功率从79.2%提升至98.3%。这些结果支持集体经验作为可扩展机器人学习的实用基础，并提供了在部署过程中无需收集额外专家纠正动作即可提高策略可靠性的路径。

title: Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies
summary: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.
tldr: PGPG is an unsupervised preference alignment framework that automatically generates pseudo-preference labels from autonomous rollouts using ordered coverage alignment with expert demonstrations, enabling effective fine-tuning of generative policies without human annotations.
tldr_zh: PGPG 是一种无监督偏好对齐框架，通过有序覆盖对齐从自主收集的轨迹中自动生成伪偏好标签，无需人工标注，即可有效微调生成式策略。
summary_zh: 生成式策略在模仿学习任务中已展现出强劲性能，但其成功往往受限于专家示范数据的稀缺性。尽管基于偏好的微调可以利用次优轨迹来提升性能，现有方法却严重依赖昂贵的人工标注。在本研究中，我们提出了一种无需人工循环监督的无监督偏好对齐框架——进度引导的偏好生成（PGPG）。该方法利用有序覆盖对齐来衡量相对于少量专家示范的序列进度，从而能够从自主采集的轨迹中自动提取伪偏好标签。此外，我们引入了关键改进以增强这些进度引导偏好的可靠性，使得预训练生成式策略无需人工设计奖励函数即可实现高效微调。在多个具有挑战性的长程操作任务套件上进行的大量实验表明，PGPG 的性能优于标准的监督式微调基线。更重要的是，我们这一概念上简洁的框架广泛适用于多类生成式策略，在与扩散策略和流匹配策略集成时展现出强大的通用性。

title: Revealing and Bridging the Physical Executability Gap in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.
tldr: This paper reveals a physical executability gap in VLN evaluation due to permissive contact models in simulators, and proposes VeSTA, a framework combining Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization and a Traversability Risk Critic to align VLN policies with physically executable and semantically valid trajectories, validated in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了仿真器中宽松接触模型导致的VLN物理可执行性差距，并提出VeSTA框架，通过轨迹相对组策略优化和可穿越性风险评论器将VLN策略与物理可执行且语义有效的轨迹对齐，在仿真和真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 连续视觉-语言导航（VLN）通常通过目标到达成功率进行评估，其隐含假设是该指标能够反映智能体执行基于语言引导行为的能力。我们发现这一假设可能失效：当前仿真器中宽松的接触模型可能掩盖物理上不可行的动作，从而在语义能力与具身实现之间产生物理可执行性鸿沟。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了视觉-语义可穿越性对齐框架（VeSTA），该框架将VLN策略与物理可执行的未来轨迹相对齐。我们将视觉-语义可穿越性定义为预测满足语义有效、几何可行且物理鲁棒的指令条件轨迹的能力。VeSTA通过两种互补机制解决这一错配问题：在轨迹生成中提升可执行性支持，以及在多模态未来轨迹中进行风险感知选择。具体而言，轨迹相对组策略优化利用严格接触反馈将候选分布重塑至可执行区域，而可穿越性风险评判器则学习一个风险调整的标量效用，用于候选轨迹的逐项未来选择。在R2R和RxR上的实验表明，现有VLN智能体对仿真器接触语义存在显著依赖。在严格接触评估下，VeSTA在保持或提升目标到达性能的同时显著减少了碰撞引发的失败，且受控的真实世界机器人实验提供了证据，表明所学偏好能够超越仿真环境实现迁移。

title: SpaRV: Sparse Radiance Voxels for Scalable Geometrically Consistent LiDAR-Visual Mapping and Rendering
summary: Robotic simulation, navigation, and inspection need photorealistic and geometrically accurate maps. Radiance fields achieve photorealism, but building them from robot data raises three challenges. A robot's trajectory serves its task, not reconstruction, so images from few viewpoints leave the geometry under-constrained. Residual errors in camera poses and intrinsics blur the map. The map's GPU memory grows with scene size, which limits its level of detail in large scenes. We present \textbf{SpaRV}, a \textbf{Spa}rse \textbf{R}adiance \textbf{V}oxel map rendered by differentiable ray marching, which lets irregular LiDAR scans supervise it alongside images. LiDAR depth and occupancy anchor the under-constrained geometry, and normal and smoothness regularizers keep it smooth between LiDAR points. To correct camera errors, SpaRV alternates map training with photometric optimization of the camera poses and focal lengths. To bound GPU memory in training and rendering, SpaRV holds one submap at a time at full resolution and the rest at coarser octree levels. Experiments show that SpaRV keeps the geometry consistent away from the captured trajectory and sharpens textures by optimizing the camera parameters. On one 24\,GB GPU, SpaRV reconstructs a university campus captured in 63{,}582 images and simulates other cameras and LiDARs. Our code will be released at \url{https://github.com/hku-mars/SpaRV}.
tldr: SpaRV introduces a sparse radiance voxel mapping method that integrates LiDAR and camera data to create geometrically consistent, photorealistic maps for robotic simulation and navigation, with memory-efficient submap handling.
tldr_zh: SpaRV提出了一种稀疏辐射体素建图方法，结合LiDAR和相机数据为机器人仿真和导航创建几何一致且逼真的地图，并通过子图管理降低内存占用。
summary_zh: 摘要：机器人仿真、导航与检测需要既具有照片级真实感又几何精确的地图。辐射场能够实现照片级真实感，但从机器人数据构建辐射场面临三项挑战。机器人的轨迹服务于其任务而非重建，因此来自少数视角的图像使几何约束不足。相机位姿与内参的残余误差会使地图模糊。地图的GPU内存随场景规模增长，从而限制了大规模场景中的细节水平。我们提出\textbf{SpaRV}——一种通过可微光线步进渲染的\textbf{稀疏}辐射\textbf{体素}地图，它允许不规则的LiDAR扫描与图像共同监督其构建。LiDAR深度与占据信息锚定欠约束的几何，法线与平滑正则化项保持LiDAR点之间的平滑性。为纠正相机误差，SpaRV交替进行地图训练与相机位姿及焦距的光度优化。为在训练和渲染中限制GPU内存，SpaRV每次仅以全分辨率持有一个子地图，其余子地图保持在较粗的八叉树层级。实验表明，SpaRV在远离采集轨迹的区域保持几何一致性，并通过优化相机参数锐化纹理。在一块24\,GB GPU上，SpaRV重建了由63{,}582张图像采集的大学校园，并能仿真其他相机与LiDAR。我们的代码将发布于\url{https://github.com/hku-mars/SpaRV}。

title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
summary: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.
tldr: This paper proposes a post-hoc correction to latent world model planning by fitting a linear Gauss-Markov transition to identify and down-weight noisy latent directions, improving planning success in navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种对潜在世界模型规划的事后修正方法，通过拟合线性高斯-马尔可夫转移来识别并降低噪声潜在方向，从而提高导航任务中的规划成功率。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型使智能体能够在潜在空间中进行规划。规划器搜索使成本最小化的动作序列，而该成本通常是预测的终端潜在状态与目标潜在状态之间的$\ell_2$距离。然而，潜在状态中包含了部分噪声：用于防止世界模型训练过程中表征坍缩的正则化器会在无信号的方向上引入方差。我们表明，同一正则化器也为裁剪潜在空间中的此类噪声提供了结构基础。SIGReg将每个时间步的潜在边缘分布驱动为标准高斯分布，并进一步假设潜在序列为高斯-马尔可夫过程，则转移为线性转移，其协方差由映射本身固定，即$z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$。因此，拟合状态动力学$A$无需额外成本即可得到协方差，并且在其特征基下，每个潜在方向都带有自身的不确定性。此外，将$A$约束为正交矩阵可使该基在时间步间保持固定，因此一个特征基可度量任意步数上的不确定性，并作为计算规划成本的稳定基。随后，我们将$\ell_2$成本限制在状态动力学以最小不确定性前向传播的$k$维子空间上。该修正为事后处理：编码器、预测器、展开过程和规划器均保持不变，仅需拟合一个受约束的矩阵$A$。我们在六个环境中进行评估，结果显示在二维导航任务TwoRoom和PointMaze上取得了显著提升，在更困难的规划设置下，相比普通$\ell_2$成本的成功率最高提升了$+54.7$个百分点。代码可在https://github.com/yjang43/lp2获取。

title: Self-Crystallizing Behavior Trees: Amortizing Foundation-Model Reasoning into Deterministic Control for Autonomous Drones
summary: Classical robot control, Finite State Machines and Behavior Trees (BTs), is deterministic and inspectable but fixed at design time: it fails on situations its designers did not anticipate. Foundation models can synthesize new control logic at runtime, at a cost in latency and non-determinism hard to accept in safety-critical aerial systems. Existing LLM-driven approaches keep the model in the loop permanently and discard what it produces. We propose Self-Crystallizing Behavior Trees (SCBT), in which the foundation model is a compiler rather than a runtime. When a BT node fails, an LLM proposes a minimal, mission-agnostic subtree patch; CMA-ES tunes its parameters in simulation; a contextual bandit decides whether a stored patch or a new LLM call is worth its cost; and a three-stage admission pipeline (static check, invariant-monitored replays, an empirical margin over the unpatched tree) admits only patches that demonstrably recover. Admitted patches are stored in a fleet library and, once the LLM call rate decays, crystallized into a deterministic BT that no human wrote. We implement SCBT on Microsoft Project AirSim with a schema-constrained LLM pipeline (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and a lockstep simulator. Over three seeds of a 20-episode learning phase with wind-gust and battery failures, SCBT used $11\pm1.4$ LLM calls against 26 for whole-tree regeneration and 22 without a library, with 0.33 calls per episode in the second half. The crystallized trees, 28 and 33 nodes with two patches each, reached $97\pm2\%$ mission success with no learning running, against 12\% for the unpatched tree and 98\% for a hand-coded expert tree, and reproduce decision traces exactly when re-ticked offline. Two negative results: replay admission rejected useful wind recoveries by attributing wind-induced geofence excursions to the patch, and a static-only ablation generalized better to held-out failures.
tldr: SCBT uses a foundation model as a compiler to generate subtrees that are optimized, validated, and crystallized into deterministic Behavior Trees for autonomous drones, achieving high mission success with minimal LLM calls.
tldr_zh: SCBT将基础模型用作编译器，生成子树并进行优化、验证和结晶为确定性行为树，用于自主无人机，以极少的LLM调用实现高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 经典机器人控制、有限状态机与行为树（BT）具备确定性与可检查性，但在设计时即固定不变：面对设计者未预见的情形时会失效。基础模型可以在运行时合成新的控制逻辑，但代价是延迟与非确定性，这在安全关键的空中系统中难以接受。已有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法将模型永久置于回路中，并丢弃其产出的内容。我们提出自结晶行为树（SCBT），其中基础模型扮演编译器而非运行时角色。当行为树节点失败时，LLM 提议一个最小化且与任务无关的子树补丁；CMA-ES 在仿真中调节其参数；上下文赌博机判断是使用已存储补丁还是重新调用 LLM 更值得其成本；三级准入流水线（静态检查、基于不变量监测的重放、与未修补树相比的经验性裕度）仅接纳能明确恢复任务完成的补丁。通过准入的补丁被存入机队库，一旦 LLM 调用率衰减，即结晶为无人编写过的确定性行为树。我们在微软 Project AirSim 上实现了 SCBT，采用模式约束的 LLM 流水线（Gemini 3.1 Pro）与锁步仿真器。在包含阵风与电池故障的 20 幕学习阶段中，跨越三个随机种子，SCBT 使用 $11\pm1.4$ 次 LLM 调用，而整树再生成方式需要 26 次、无库版本需要 22 次，后半程每幕调用次数为 0.33。结晶后的树分别含 28 与 33 个节点、各含两个补丁，在不运行学习的情况下达到 $97\pm2\%$ 的任务成功率，而未修补的树仅为 12\%，手工编写的专家树为 98\%，且离线重新触发时能精确复现决策轨迹。两项负面结果：重放式准入将风致地理围栏偏移归因于补丁而拒绝了有效的风况恢复；仅静态检查的消融实验在未见的失败情形上泛化效果更好。

title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
summary: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces AnyGoal, a benchmark and library for evaluating world model generalization to goal-shifted tasks, revealing that current models fail on compositional recombinations of familiar state and action factors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AnyGoal，一个用于评估世界模型在目标偏移任务上泛化能力的基准和库，揭示了现有模型在熟悉状态和动作因素组合上的失败。
summary_zh: 摘要：世界模型的目标在于捕捉环境的动态特性。其巨大的吸引力在于，它能使代理借助世界模型进行规划并模拟一系列行动过程。然而，要使这些用途可靠，所学到的动态规律必须在专家演示中观察到的具体状态-动作组合之外也能良好运作。尽管如此，数据覆盖范围、动态泛化能力与下游规划性能之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角来研究这一关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态与动作因素重组为有效的动态规律？为回答此问题，我们引入了AnyGoal基准，这是一个基于广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标转移任务变体集合，并配套提供了开源库。每项任务设计为世界模型在学习了潜在动态后均能企及：个体状态因素与动作均保持在训练支持范围内，但其组合在专家轨迹中的代表性不足。在多种环境和世界模型家族中，我们发现当前模型在这些重组情境下始终表现出失效现象。通过跨模型家族、交互机制及评估指标来审视动态与表征层面的失败，我们研究了当前世界模型在何处能够泛化，以及目标转移预测与规划仍面临哪些挑战。综合而言，本框架、基准与分析为评估世界模型向新规划任务泛化的进展提供了基础。

title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
summary: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs.
