We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.
tldr: BetaMem introduces a six-layer memory framework with dual-level write contracts and failure-driven recursive self-improvement, improving long-horizon embodied agent memory performance on benchmarks like M3-Bench-robot and EgoLifeQA.
tldr_zh: BetaMem 提出了一个六层记忆框架，通过双重写入约束和失败驱动的递归自我改进，提升了具身智能体在长时任务中的记忆性能。
summary_zh: 长程具身智能体面临时间混淆、记录不完整或失真、固定记忆规则导致的重复错误，以及持续增长的存储与检索成本。我们提出BetaMem，一个通过六个相互关联的层次构建和演化可溯源长期记忆的框架，这六层分别为：工作记忆、空间记忆、实体记忆、情景记忆、经验记忆和程序记忆。双层写入契约约束操作可执行性和内容来源支持：监督微调学习合规的记忆操作，而强化学习将重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证相结合，奖励完整、准确的记录，惩罚遗漏、扭曲及无来源支持的内容。我们通过沿记忆操作的因果序列进行诊断，以及由独立回放门控的局部规则修复，实现故障驱动的策略递归自我改进。原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘框架化为存储与读取预算约束下的成本-效用分配。使用开源Qwen3.5-9B模型进行记忆生成，BetaMem在M3-Bench-robot上取得48.08%的综合得分，在LoCoMo上为92.08%，在OpenEQA EM-EQA上为72.6%，在EgoLifeQA上为62.4%，在各自的评估协议下均列于所列举记忆方法中的最高水平。对模型进行记忆生成训练使契约通过率从50.9%提升至86.2%，同时每次存储动作的输出令牌数减少47.3%。使用独立的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在EMem-Bench上评估，平均成功率达38.4%，平均错误复发率为24.9%。在采用相近规模开源模型的评估方法中，我们表现最优。分类结果显示，我们在跨观测整合信息、长历史事件回忆以及个人习惯推断方面具有优势。

title: A Semantic Knowledge Graph Construction Pipeline for Vehicle Intention Prediction in nuScenes
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly used in autonomous driving (AD) to make traffic scene entities and relations explicit for prediction and reasoning. Existing traffic-scene KGs, however, primarily emphasize trajectory forecasting or general scene understanding. This paper presents the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), a focused Web Ontology Language (OWL)-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context. NIKG instantiates nuScenes scenes as a self-describing Turtle graph and promotes three intention-relevant relations to first-class properties of each scene participant: ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and time to collision (TTC) risk. The pipeline uses a small input contract available in many ego-centric driving datasets: ego pose, tracked object annotations, and temporal keyframe order. NIKG is released as an ontology-backed, self-describing graph artifact together with a reproducible construction pipeline and validation protocol for ego-centric intention context. Applying this pipeline to nuScenes mini yields a graph of 211,335 triples across 404 keyframes; under the validation protocol, ego-relative motion labels achieve 92.5% forward consistency. Coverage, semantic consistency, and temporal coherence analyses over this artifact are further reported. NIKG occupies the space between scene-oriented traffic KGs and intention-prediction models: a small, explicit semantic layer intended to support downstream work such as knowledge graph embedding (KGE), SPARQL-based feature extraction, or hybrid neuro-symbolic reasoning.
tldr: This paper introduces the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), an OWL-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context, which instantiates nuScenes scenes as Turtle graphs and promotes intention-relevant relations (ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and TTC risk) to first-class properties. The pipeline, applied to nuScenes mini, produces a graph of 211,335 triples and achieves 92.5% forward consistency for ego-relative motion labels, providing a semantic layer to support downstream tasks like KGE and neuro-symbolic reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了nuScenes意图知识图谱（NIKG），一种基于OWL的语义表示和构建流程，用于以自我为中心的车辆意图上下文，将nuScenes场景实例化为Turtle图，并将与意图相关的三个关系（自我相对运动、空间配置和TTC风险）提升为一等属性。该流程应用于nuScenes mini，生成了包含211,335个三元组的图，并在自我相对运动标签上实现了92.5%的前向一致性，为下游任务（如KGE和神经符号推理）提供了一个语义层。
summary_zh: 知识图谱（KGs）在自动驾驶（AD）领域中应用日益广泛，用以明确表达交通场景中的实体及其关系，以支持预测与推理。然而，现有的交通场景知识图谱主要侧重于轨迹预测或通用场景理解。本文提出了nuScenes意图知识图谱（NIKG），一种基于Web本体语言（OWL）的聚焦于自我车辆意图上下文的语义表示与构建流程。NIKG将nuScenes场景实例化为自描述Turtle图，并将三种与意图相关的关系统一提升为每个场景参与者的首要属性：自车相对运动、空间构型以及碰撞时间（TTC）风险。该流程仅需多种以自我为中心的驾驶数据集中常用的小型输入契约：自车位姿、跟踪目标标注以及时间关键帧顺序。NIKG作为基于本体的自描述图构件发布，并配有可复现的构建流程及针对自我中心意图上下文的验证协议。将该流程应用于nuScenes mini数据集，生成了包含404个关键帧、211,335条三元组的图；在验证协议下，自车相对运动标签的前向一致性达到92.5%。本文还对该图构件进行了覆盖度、语义一致性和时间一致性分析。NIKG填补了面向场景的交通知识图谱与意图预测模型之间的空白：作为一个简洁、显式的语义层，旨在支持知识图谱嵌入（KGE）、基于SPARQL的特征提取或混合神经符号推理等下游任务。

title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
summary: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
tldr: PVBench is a benchmark for measuring physical plausibility in video generation across 46 dimensions, using object-level physical measurements and including embodied agents like robot arms and humanoids.
tldr_zh: PVBench 是一个用于量化视频生成中物理合理性的基准，涵盖 46 个维度，利用物体级物理测量，并涉及机器人臂、人形机器人等具身智能体。
summary_zh: 近期推出的视频生成模型能够产生视觉上引人入胜的输出，然而其物理合理性仍未得到充分度量。物理合理性旨在检验生成对象是否符合几何学、运动学、动力学及守恒定律。现有基准要么依赖粗略的视觉-语言模型评判，要么面向具身世界模型而非视频生成本身。为此，我们提出PVBench——一个物理视频基准，从七大领域、46个维度定量衡量生成视频的合理性，涵盖：i)指令与语义保真度，ii)行为与因果一致性，iii)感知与时间质量，iv)几何与空间一致性，v)材料属性与场状态，vi)运动学与时空持续性，vii)以及结合守恒定律的力学合理性。PVBench包含600个精心设计的提示词，其中30%涉及物理具身智能体，如机械臂、人形机器人、四足机器人及多智能体系统。对于具有物理可解性的挑战性维度，每个维度均配以专门的视觉模型，以提取可验证且基于物理的度量，如对象级6D姿态、度量尺度、表面法向量、运动学数据及数值守恒定律残差。因此，该基准不仅避免了完全依赖主观评分，同时支持文本到视频及图像到视频的生成任务。最后，通过人工评估，我们验证了自动指标与人类判断之间的一致性。同时，我们评估了主流的开源与闭源模型，并提出了若干见解。通过发布该基准、提示词及校准协议，我们旨在推动基于物理的视频生成研究。

title: Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models
summary: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.
tldr: This paper proposes replacing expensive search in hierarchical world models with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through a frozen high-level predictor, achieving faster inference and comparable success rates on manipulation and navigation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用轻量级目标条件网络替代分层世界模型中的昂贵搜索，通过冻结的高层预测器训练，在操作和导航基准上实现更快推理和相近成功率。
summary_zh: 分层世界模型通过将预测状态从粗略模型传递到低层控制器来实现长期规划。选择这些状态可能代价高昂：上层规划器需反复对候选宏动作轨迹进行微分。我们用一个轻量级的目标条件网络替代这一搜索过程，该网络通过冻结的高层预测器进行训练。网络提供条件向量，而预测器生成下一个潜在路径点。训练采用事后目标及离线轨迹上的状态预测损失，无需搜索解目标或宏动作标签。推理阶段保留自回归的高层展开，但无需高层候选优化。我们在与H-JEPA一起发布的共享潜在HWM检查点上评估了该方法，使用三个骨干种子和每个骨干的三个头初始化。在统一评估协议下，Cube上的平均成功率为70.4%，Push-T为48.7%，FourRoom为100.0%，Visual AntMaze为71.1%。该方法在三个环境中优于对应的HWM搜索基线，在Push-T上均值相同。在NVIDIA L40S上的专项测量显示，批量评估的端到端加速比为1.28至4.39倍。消融实验表明，状态自适应条件化是一个稳定的贡献因素，而预测器介导的子目标和无限制条件则在环境依赖性上各有优势。

title: UBD-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Unimodal Branch Degradation in Multimodal Perception for Autonomous Driving
summary: Multimodal perception improves autonomous-driving performance by combining complementary sensor information. However, stronger multimodal predictions do not necessarily imply stronger representations in each modality-specific branch. Such branch-level weaknesses can remain hidden in conventional output-level evaluation. We introduce UBD-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying unimodal branch degradation (UBD) in multimodal perception. UBD-Bench uses a Paired Frozen-Branch Probe to compare the task-relevant representation quality of the same modality after independent unimodal training and multimodal joint training under matched decoding conditions. Across four autonomous-driving perception tasks and 10 models, we find that Camera branches consistently degrade after multimodal joint training, whereas LiDAR branches exhibit weaker and more model-dependent changes, revealing a pronounced modality asymmetry. Hierarchical probing further shows that Camera-branch degradation extends from the visual backbone through the Camera-to-BEV pathway and is most severe at the pre-fusion Camera BEV representation. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce unimodal-to-multimodal distillation at the degraded representation. This intervention consistently improves both Camera-branch Probe performance and full-model performance across all four tasks. These results show that multimodal gains can coexist with degraded unimodal representations, highlighting branch-level representation quality as an important dimension for evaluating and improving multimodal perception.
tldr: This paper introduces UBD-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating unimodal branch degradation in multimodal perception for autonomous driving, and proposes a distillation intervention that improves both branch-level and full-model performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UBD-Bench基准，用于评估自动驾驶多模态感知中的单模态分支退化，并提出了蒸馏干预，既能改善分支性能，也能改善整体模型性能。
summary_zh: 多模态感知通过融合互补的传感器信息来提升自动驾驶性能。然而，更强的多模态预测并不必然意味着各个模态专用分支具备更强的表征能力。这类分支层面的弱点在传统的输出级评估中可能难以显现。我们提出了UBD-Bench，一个系统研究多模态感知中单模态分支退化（UBD）的系统性基准。UBD-Bench采用配对冻结分支探针（Paired Frozen-Branch Probe），在匹配解码条件下，对比同一模态经独立单模态训练与多模态联合训练后的任务相关表征质量。在四个自动驾驶感知任务和10个模型上，我们发现相机分支在多模态联合训练后持续退化，而激光雷达分支的变化较弱且更依赖具体模型，呈现出显著的模态不对称性。分层探针分析进一步表明，相机分支的退化从视觉骨干网络延伸至相机到BEV的转换路径，并在融合前的相机BEV表征处最为严重。基于这一诊断结果，我们引入了从单模态到多模态的蒸馏方法作用于退化的表征。该干预措施在全部四个任务中一致地提升了相机分支的探针性能以及整体模型性能。这些结果表明，多模态增益可以与退化的单模态表征共存，凸显了分支级表征质量作为评估和改进多模态感知的重要维度。

title: Robotic Physical Comparison of Biologically Motivated and Counterfactual Sensory Arrangements using Biomimetic Skin
summary: Human skin contains diverse mechanoreceptors, including Merkel cells and Pacinian corpuscles, each localized in specific regions. Although their spatial organization is known to be shaped by molecular signaling and neural induction during development, experimentally examining its functional significance under controlled conditions in living systems remains challenging. In particular, physically comparing alternative receptor arrangements that do not occur biologically is difficult. In this study, we developed a layered biomimetic robotic skin designed to mimic key structural features of human skin tissue by embedding receptor-analog sensors within compliant soft media. Using this platform, we implemented both biologically motivated and counterfactual sensory arrangements and quantitatively evaluated their performance across three passive tactile tasks: detection of weak contacts, a two-point discrimination-like assessment, and texture identification. Arrangements reflecting key features of the biologically motivated sensory organization exhibited higher performance than the alternative configurations examined. This study addresses a biological question concerning how spatial organization influences tactile function by presenting a biomimetic robotic approach that enables physical and empirical comparison of biologically motivated and counterfactual sensory arrangements that are difficult to investigate in living systems.
tldr: This paper presents a biomimetic robotic skin platform to physically compare biologically motivated and counterfactual mechanoreceptor arrangements across passive tactile tasks, showing that biological-like arrangements perform better.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种仿生机器人皮肤平台，通过物理实验比较生物学启发与反事实的机械感受器布局在被动触觉任务中的表现，发现类生物布局性能更优。
summary_zh: 人类皮肤包含多种机械感受器，包括默克尔细胞和环层小体，它们分别定位于特定区域。尽管已知这些感受器的空间组织在发育过程中受分子信号和神经诱导的塑造，但在受控条件下于活体系统中实验检验其功能意义仍然具有挑战性。尤其难以对生物学上不存在的替代性感受器排布进行物理比较。在本研究中，我们开发了一种分层仿生机器人皮肤，通过将类感受器传感器嵌入柔顺软介质中，模拟人体皮肤组织的关键结构特征。利用该平台，我们实现了基于生物学启发的感官排布及反事实感官排布，并在三项被动触觉任务中定量评估其性能：弱接触检测、类似两点辨别能力的评估以及纹理识别。反映生物学启发的感官组织关键特征的排布方式在性能上优于所考察的替代配置。本研究通过提出一种仿生机器人方法，实现了对难以在活体系统中研究的生物学启发排布与反事实感官排布进行物理和实证比较，从而回答了一个关于空间组织如何影响触觉功能的生物学问题。

title: A Probabilistic, Rotation-Preserving Kernel Operator Surrogate for Continuum-Robot Design Spaces
summary: We develop an uncertainty-aware, operator-learning-based surrogate for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) that generalizes across robot design and actuation while predicting the complete equilibrium configuration. Our central idea is a nonstationary Gaussian-process (GP) kernel whose metric is learned by a shallow neural network from mechanics-aware design coordinates. The network learns how similarity changes across design space, while the resulting kernel defines the design-to-pose operator, its posterior uncertainty, and a criterion for sequential simulator acquisition. We represent backbone position and rotational strain with spatial kernels and reconstruct orientation directly on SO(3), preserving valid material frames and tendon geometry. We use ASkotch with Nystrom preconditioning for scalable kernel operator solves and a separate Nystrom approximation for posterior covariance. Experiments show that kernel-coverage acquisition reduces mean trajectory error by approximately 15% relative to IID sampling, while posterior variance increases for increasingly unsupported designs. Compared with prior neural-operator TDCR models, the method is 30-50% more accurate using approximately 5x fewer training designs while additionally providing posterior uncertainty estimates.
tldr: This paper introduces a probabilistic, rotation-preserving Gaussian-process operator surrogate for tendon-driven continuum robots, using a neural-network-learned kernel to predict equilibrium configurations from design coordinates and provide uncertainty estimates with efficient computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腱驱动连续体机器人的概率、保旋转的高斯过程算子替代模型，通过神经网络学习的核从设计坐标预测平衡构型并提供不确定性估计，同时实现高效计算。
summary_zh: 我们开发了一种基于不确定性感知、算子学习的新型代理模型，用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs），该模型能够跨机器人设计与驱动条件进行泛化，同时预测完整的平衡构型。我们的核心思想是引入一种非平稳高斯过程（GP）核，其度量由浅层神经网络基于力学感知的设计坐标学习得到。该网络学习相似性如何随设计空间变化，而由此生成的核则定义了从设计到位形的算子、其后验不确定性以及序列模拟器采集的准则。我们使用空间核表示骨干位置与旋转应变，并直接在SO(3)上重构姿态，从而保证材料坐标系和肌腱几何的有效性。我们采用带有Nyström预条件子的ASkotch进行可扩展的核算子求解，并使用独立的Nyström近似计算后验协方差。实验表明，与独立同分布（IID）采样相比，基于核覆盖的采集策略将平均轨迹误差降低了约15%，而对日益缺乏支撑的设计，后验方差则相应增大。与先前的神经算子TDCR模型相比，本方法在训练设计数量减少约5倍的情况下精度提高了30%–50%，同时额外提供了后验不确定性估计。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Planning Representations for Monocular Flight with Cross-Modal Supervision
summary: Existing high-speed navigation systems for micro aerial vehicles (MAVs) commonly rely on depth cameras, stereo vision, or LiDAR to obtain explicit geometric information, while monocular cameras offer a lighter and lower-cost alternative. However, monocular flight remains challenging because RGB images offer no direct metric cues and visual appearance varies considerably across environments. We propose a geometry-aware monocular visual planning framework that predicts trajectories from two image frames, their relative pose, and the MAV state. Without explicitly reconstructing depth, the proposed method complements the downstream planning objective with feature-level geometric supervision by transferring the planning-relevant representation learned by a privileged depth expert to the RGB planner through cross-modal distillation. The framework first trains a depth-based geometric expert, then distills its planning features into a monocular branch using paired RGB-D observations, and finally adapts the planner to the downstream trajectory planning objective. This design encourages the policy to learn planning-relevant geometric features, enabling collision avoidance. We further use a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulator to render visual observations for data collection, paired RGB-D supervision, and simulation evaluation. The planner trained in simulation is then deployed in real-world environments without real-world fine-tuning, achieving obstacle avoidance at speeds of up to 6.5 m/s.
tldr: This paper proposes a monocular vision-based planning framework for MAV flight that learns geometry-aware features via cross-modal distillation from a depth-based expert, enabling collision avoidance at speeds up to 6.5 m/s in real-world deployment without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于微型飞行器单目飞行的几何感知规划框架，通过跨模态蒸馏从深度专家中学习规划相关特征，实现了无需微调即可在真实世界中以高达6.5米/秒的速度避障。
summary_zh: 现有微型飞行器（MAVs）的高速导航系统通常依赖深度相机、立体视觉或激光雷达来获取显式几何信息，而单目相机则提供了一种更轻便、更低成本的替代方案。然而，单目飞行仍具挑战性，因为RGB图像无法提供直接的度量线索，且不同环境下的视觉外观差异显著。我们提出了一种几何感知的单目视觉规划框架，该框架从两帧图像、其相对位姿及飞行器状态中预测轨迹。在不显式重建深度的情况下，所提方法通过跨模态蒸馏，将特权深度专家学习到的规划相关表示迁移至RGB规划器，从而以特征级几何监督补充下游规划目标。该框架首先训练基于深度的几何专家，随后利用配对的RGB-D观测将其规划特征蒸馏至单目分支，最后将规划器适配至下游轨迹规划目标。这一设计促使策略学习与规划相关的几何特征，从而实现避障。我们进一步使用3D高斯溅射（3DGS）模拟器渲染视觉观测，用于数据采集、配对RGB-D监督及仿真评估。在仿真中训练得到的规划器无需真实世界微调即可部署至实际环境，实现了最高6.5 m/s速度下的避障能力。

title: Self-Supervised Inertial Odometry
summary: Learning inertial odometry for a new platform usually requires ground-truth trajectories. We show that an inertial odometry model can instead be trained from scratch by a myopic teacher that integrates the IMU over each short window independently, a scheme we call integration self-supervision.Interestingly, although supervised only by short-window velocity changes, the student learns to directly predict velocity, and does so more accurately than its integration teacher. Pose graph distillation then refines the model with sequence-consistent targets from a pose graph over many windows. Training on a new platform therefore no longer requires collecting ground-truth trajectories, but only calibrating the IMU and recording data during normal operation. Across six datasets spanning pedestrians, drones, quadrupeds, and a humanoid, the same recipe with no velocity or position labels trains models that come within $0.07$~m/s average velocity error of a same-architecture supervised baseline.
tldr: This paper introduces a self-supervised method for training inertial odometry models without ground-truth trajectories, using integration self-supervision and pose graph distillation, achieving near-supervised accuracy across various platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需真实轨迹的自监督惯性里程计训练方法，通过积分自监督和位姿图蒸馏，在多种平台上达到接近监督学习的精度。
summary_zh: 为新平台学习惯性里程计通常需要地面实况轨迹。我们证明，惯性里程计模型可以通过一个短视教师从零开始训练，该教师独立地对每个短时间窗口内的IMU数据进行积分，这一方案我们称之为积分自监督。有趣的是，尽管仅通过短窗口速度变化进行监督，学生模型却学会了直接预测速度，并且其预测精度超过了积分教师。随后，位姿图蒸馏通过多个窗口上的位姿图生成序列一致的目标，进一步优化模型。因此，在新平台上训练不再需要收集地面实况轨迹，只需在正常操作期间校准IMU并记录数据即可。跨越行人、无人机、四足机器人和人形机器人六个数据集，相同的配方在无速度或位置标签的情况下，训练出的模型平均速度误差与同架构的有监督基线相差在$0.07$~m/s以内。

title: InteractAgent: Agentic Human Motion Interaction with Memory-Augmented Reflection
summary: Long-horizon human-scene interaction requires coordinated spatial reasoning, physical feasibility, and the ability to recover from compounding execution errors. Text-driven motion models are largely scene-agnostic and lack closed-loop correction, while geometry-conditioned approaches depend on paired scene-motion training or explicit 3D preprocessing that limits generalization to novel layouts and open-vocabulary goals. We present InteractAgent, an agentic multimodal LLM system for long-horizon human-scene interaction that plans, executes, observes, and reflects in a closed loop, using a single MLLM as both planner and evaluator and a frozen MotionLLM as the executor. InteractAgent integrates Online Observation for step-wise recovery decisions (continue/redo/replan) and Memory-Augmented Reflection for multi-round plan refinement with adaptive stopping. On UniHSI, InteractAgent improves task success and reduces penetration compared with training-free baselines. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/InteractAgent.
tldr: InteractAgent introduces an agentic multimodal LLM system that plans, executes, observes, and reflects in a closed loop for long-horizon human-scene interaction, improving task success and reducing penetration on the UniHSI benchmark.
tldr_zh: InteractAgent 提出了一种智能多模态LLM系统，通过闭环规划、执行、观察和反思，在UniHSI基准上提高了长期人-场景交互的任务成功率并减少了穿透。
summary_zh: 长程人-场景交互要求协调的空间推理、物理可行性以及从复合执行错误中恢复的能力。文本驱动的运动模型大多对场景无关，且缺乏闭环修正能力，而基于几何条件的方法则依赖于配对场景-运动训练或显式3D预处理，这限制了对新布局和开放词汇目标的可泛化性。我们提出了InteractAgent，一个用于长程人-场景交互的智能体多模态大语言模型系统，该系统在闭环中进行规划、执行、观察和反思，使用单一多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为规划器和评估器，并使用冻结的MotionLLM作为执行器。InteractAgent集成了在线观察以进行逐步恢复决策（继续/重做/重新规划），以及带自适应停止的记忆增强反思，用于多轮计划细化。在UniHSI上，与无需训练的基线方法相比，InteractAgent提高了任务成功率并减少了穿透。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/InteractAgent。

title: Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy
summary: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.
tldr: This paper proposes a training-only foreground attraction loss for camera-based weakly supervised 3D semantic occupancy models with sparse Gaussian representations, improving foreground concentration and IoU without changing inference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅用于训练的、基于前景吸引的损失函数，用于相机基弱监督三维语义占用模型中的稀疏高斯表示，在不改变推理的情况下提高了前景集中度和IoU。
summary_zh: 基于相机的三维语义占用模型可以通过将预测结果渲染到图像中，并以二维伪标签进行监督，从而在无需三维标签的情况下完成训练。在这种以稀疏高斯表示进行训练的方式中，高斯位置仅通过逐像素渲染损失来学习，我们假设这种损失对小前景对象赋予的权重较小。在训练好的GaussianFlowOcc模型中，前景体素上的高斯密度平均仅为背景体素上的1.62倍。我们提出了一种仅用于训练的“前景吸引”损失函数，该损失利用伪深度将前景伪标签像素反投影至三维空间，并将邻近的高斯向这些三维点拉近，同时优先选择那些已经预测出目标类别的高斯；推理网络保持不变。在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，该损失在三种随机种子下将该集中度提升至2.40。在三种随机种子下，平均前景IoU从6.29提升至6.96，且每种种子下的结果均有所提高，而平均mIoU的变化（13.53至13.82）则处于基线不同种子间的波动范围内。单次运行的消融实验进一步表明，伪标签目标优于置于真实体素处的目标，且仅作用于高斯位置是不够的；同时，单种子测试显示，在推理阶段保留较少高斯时，模型性能下降幅度更小。

title: Adaptive Bendpoint Formation in Octopus-Inspired Soft Continuum Arms
summary: Octopuses exhibit a powerful form of embodied intelligence from a highly adaptable soft body. One key mechanism is the ability to instantiate bending points at any location along the arm, which enables performant and dexterous behaviours. Taking inspiration from the octopus for its dexterity, this study focuses on changing the curvature of a tendon-actuated arm by adaptively changing the anchoring end-point along the arm. An array of inflatable shells is integrated into the arm, where inflating a shell causes an increase in friction at the location, jamming the tendon and creating a temporary new anchoring point. The novel soft actuator does not break the continuity of the arm between the actuated segment and the loose segment. Experiments show that the actuated segment has a non-constant bell-shaped curvature which is comparable to that of a real octopus arm during a reaching motion. Compared to conventional single-tendon continuum manipulators, the proposed design offers an expanded workspace and enhanced dexterity through the ability to independently shape different regions of the arm through selective curvature tuning. At the same time, it avoids the mechanical complexity typically associated with multi-segment, multi-actuator systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a novel octopus-inspired soft continuum arm with inflatable shells that create temporary anchoring points via friction jamming, enabling adaptive bendpoint formation and enhanced dexterity without mechanical complexity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种受章鱼启发的软体连续臂，通过可充气外壳在局部增大摩擦、形成临时锚点，实现了自适应弯曲点形成和增强的灵巧性，同时避免了多段多驱动器的机械复杂性。
summary_zh: 章鱼展现出一种强大的具身智能，源于其高度适应性的柔软身体。其中一个关键机制是能够沿手臂任意位置形成弯曲点，从而实现高性能、灵巧的行为。本研究受章鱼灵巧性的启发，聚焦于通过自适应改变肌腱驱动臂上的锚定端点来改变其曲率。手臂中集成了一组可充气外壳，充气时会使该位置的摩擦力增大，从而卡住肌腱并形成临时的新锚定点。这种新型软体执行器不会破坏驱动段与松弛段之间手臂的连续性。实验表明，驱动段具有非恒定的钟形曲率，与章鱼手臂在伸展运动中的曲率相当。与传统的单肌腱连续体操纵器相比，所提出的设计通过选择性曲率调节独立塑造手臂不同区域的能力，扩展了工作空间并增强了灵巧性。同时，它避免了多段、多执行器系统通常伴随的机械复杂性。

title: CusADi2: Latency-Optimized Batch Computation of Robot Kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians on the GPU
summary: Trajectory optimization methods, from sampling-based zero-order to gradient-based first- and second-order approaches, require many evaluations of dynamical system functions, i.e., functions derived from a robot's dynamical model, such as forward kinematics and their Jacobians and Hessians. These evaluations are largely independent, e.g., across sampled trajectories or time steps, and can thus be evaluated in parallel as a batch. When used to make decisions online, these methods require low latency, i.e., each batch must complete in as little wall-clock time as possible. Existing frameworks utilize modern GPU hardware primarily to parallelize across batch instances, thereby optimizing throughput but not latency. We present CusADi2, a software library that reduces the batch evaluation latency by additionally parallelizing computation within each batch instance. We benchmark forward kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians for all 67~robots in the MuJoCo Menagerie, including arms, hands, quadrupeds, humanoids, and biomechanical models, against MuJoCo XLA, MuJoCo Warp, frax, CusADi, and CasADi. CusADi2 achieves lower latency than all baselines at batch sizes of 64 to 4096, while matching them at larger batch sizes. We also demonstrate the performance advantage of CusADi2 in a sampling-based control application. All code is open-source at: https://github.com/johnviljoen/cusadi2
tldr: CusADi2 is a GPU software library that reduces batch evaluation latency for robot kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians by parallelizing within each batch instance, outperforming existing frameworks across benchmarks and enabling faster sampling-based control.
tldr_zh: CusADi2 是一个 GPU 软件库，通过在批处理实例内并行化计算，降低了机器人运动学、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵的批处理评估延迟，在多个基准测试中优于现有框架，并加速了基于采样的控制。
summary_zh: 轨迹优化方法，从基于采样的零阶方法到基于梯度的二阶方法，都需要对动力系统函数进行大量评估，即从机器人动力学模型中推导出的函数，如前向运动学及其雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵。这些评估在很大程度上是相互独立的，例如，跨采样轨迹或时间步的评估，因此可以作为一个批次并行执行。当这些方法用于在线决策时，需要较低的延迟，即每个批次必须在尽可能短的墙钟时间内完成。现有框架主要利用现代GPU硬件在批次实例之间进行并行化，从而优化吞吐量而非延迟。我们提出了CusADi2，一个软件库，通过在每个批次实例内部进一步并行化计算来减少批次评估延迟。我们针对MuJoCo Menagerie中的全部67个机器人，包括机械臂、灵巧手、四足机器人、人形机器人和生物力学模型，对前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵进行了基准测试，并与MuJoCo XLA、MuJoCo Warp、frax、CusADi和CasADi进行了对比。CusADi2在批次大小为64到4096时实现了比所有基线更低的延迟，在更大批次大小时与它们持平。我们还展示了CusADi2在基于采样的控制应用中的性能优势。所有代码均已开源，地址为：https://github.com/johnviljoen/cusadi2

title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
summary: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
tldr: This paper introduces WildAWM, a scalable open-source pipeline for synthesizing controllable computer-use environments and tasks that jointly support GUI, MCP, and CLI interactions. Training Qwen models in these synthetic worlds yields substantial gains on 8 out-of-distribution computer-use benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 WildAWM，一种可扩展的开源流程，用于合成同时支持 GUI、MCP 和 CLI 交互的可控计算机使用环境与任务。在这些合成世界中训练 Qwen 模型，在 8 个分布外计算机使用基准上取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 智能体学习正从依赖人类数据转向通过与环境互动进行学习。然而，将这种学习直接扩展到现实世界的计算机系统中颇具挑战性，且可能引入重大安全风险。为此，我们提出“野外智能体世界模型”（WildAWM），一个可扩展的流水线，用于合成可控环境和任务，以训练通用计算机使用智能体（CUA）。现有方法通常专注于单一智能体交互界面，而我们构建的可执行环境同时支持图形用户界面、模型上下文协议服务和命令行界面，使智能体能够灵活组合视觉交互、工具使用和代码执行。WildAWM完全由开源模型驱动，证明无需专有前沿模型即可生成高质量的计算机使用环境。除环境外，我们还针对任务合成中三个反复出现的挑战——确保可解性、维持足够难度以及生成可靠验证器——通过引入基于执行的质检门控机制加以解决，该机制结合了异构智能体展开、交叉评审一致性检查以及判断鲁棒性的反事实探测。由此生成的流水线合成了341个长时程环境-任务对，其中部分任务需超过100步智能体操作才能解决，即便对前沿模型也具挑战性——GPT-6-Astra仅能解决其中60%的任务。我们仅在这些合成世界中训练了两种不同规模的Qwen模型。两个模型在涵盖网页、Claw和计算机使用智能体的8个分布外基准测试中均取得了显著提升，证明在WildAWM合成世界中的学习能够广泛泛化至未见过的计算机使用任务。代码已公开于https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM。

title: ActionRoPE: Action as Coordinates for Spatially Consistent Control in Planar-Camera Game World Models
summary: Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/.
tldr: ActionRoPE introduces a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions, enabling spatially consistent action control in planar-camera game world models, and a noise scheduling method that leverages the known-new spatial structure to improve generation stability.
tldr_zh: ActionRoPE 提出了一种无需参数的动作接口，将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标旋转位置，从而在平面相机游戏世界模型中实现空间一致的动作控制，并利用已知-新结构改进生成的稳定性。
summary_zh: 游戏世界模型在实时交互生成方面取得了快速进展。然而，动作控制仍然主要通过特征条件化实现，模型需从训练数据中学习每个动作应如何移动视觉世界。这种表述方式与俯视角和等距游戏等平面相机世界存在明显不匹配。在这些世界中，玩家移动会引发几何上定义明确的平面相机位移。我们观察到，在此类世界中实现空间一致性控制的关键，在于直接在世界坐标系中表示每个动作的效果。为此，我们引入了ActionRoPE，一种无参数的动作接口，将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标旋转位置。由此，对应同一世界位置的标记在不同时间步保持相同的空间地址。这些世界坐标进一步揭示了生成中的空间不对称性：初始观测覆盖的区域在几何上已知，而新显露的区域则需要合成。因此，我们提出了坐标条件噪声调度（CNS），根据这种已知-新增结构分配逐标记的去噪调度。这使得已观测区域更早稳定，同时新内容以其为参照进行生成。与四种代表性动作条件化机制相比，我们的方法更忠实地遵循指令运动，并将最强基线下的重访漂移减少了66%。同一接口可跨视频骨干网络迁移，从1.3B到33B参数，并适用于分布外场景。项目页面：https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/。

title: K-AoI: A Spatio-Temporal Synchronization Metric for Digital Twin-based Teleoperation in Dynamic Network Environments
summary: Synchronization between a digital twin (DT) and its physical robot is critical for effective teleoperation, as mismatches directly degrade operator awareness and task performance. Existing synchronization metrics are predominantly time-based and rarely capture the spatial consequences of delayed information during motion. In this paper, we introduce Kinematic Age of Information (K-AoI), a spatio-temporal metric that weights AoI by instantaneous Cartesian velocity, translating temporal staleness into physically meaningful spatial divergence. We implement and evaluate K-AoI on a DT teleoperation testbed comprising a six-degrees-of-freedom (6-DOF) manipulator, a Unity-based twin, and controlled network impairments using tc netem across seven network conditions. Per-sample analysis shows that K-AoI exhibits rank-correlations with AoI at $ρ\leq 0.65$ across all networks, dropping to $ρ= 0.22$ under satellite connections. This shows that K-AoI is not a simple transformation of AoI, but instead captures velocity-dependent degradation effects that time-only metrics cannot resolve. We further analyze AoI tail behavior using Ultra-Low AoI (ULAoI) and find that the commonly assumed Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) model is rejected. This reflects the impact of deterministic forwarding and bounded jitter, which violate standard extreme-value assumptions. Overall, K-AoI provides a complementary and physically grounded synchronization metric, linking network delay to task-relevant spatial error in digital-twin teleoperation systems. The dataset and testbed software are publicly available at: https://github.com/luziyaotian/kaoi-testbed.
tldr: This paper proposes a Kinematic Age of Information (K-AoI) metric for digital twin-based teleoperation, which weights temporal staleness by velocity to capture spatial synchronization errors, and evaluates it under various network conditions on a 6-DOF manipulator testbed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于数字孪生遥操作的时空同步度量（K-AoI），通过速度加权将时间延迟转化为空间误差，并在6自由度机械臂测试平台上进行了评估。

title: TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions
summary: Long-term LiDAR place recognition in forests is difficult because repetitive vegetation and uneven terrain create severe structural aliasing. We diagnose Scan Context (SC) by separating candidate retrieval from fine matching: on the standardized TreeLoc++ Wild-Places protocol, a TNVD support key places a valid location in the top-25 set for approximately 99% of queries, while conventional SC matching on those candidates reaches only 61.84% mean R@1. With an identical raw-SC candidate set, terrain normalization improves max-height cells by only 1.21 points but vertical-distribution cells by 19.72 points. These observations motivate Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC), which preserves the SC ring-sector topology while encoding terrain-relative vertical probability distributions. Under the standardized TreeLoc++ protocol, TNVD-SC reaches 91.83% mean R@1 and attains the highest R@1 mean and R@1 stability among the compared methods, while TreeLoc++ remains stronger in mean MR, MF1, and AUC. The unchanged method reaches 85.14% mean R@1 on the four-session CVTNet-style NCLT evaluation. A lossless count-coded implementation with exact hierarchical Jensen-Shannon search reduces descriptor payload by 3.86x and compute latency by 23.8% without changing the audited retrieval outputs.
tldr: This paper diagnoses Scan Context failures in forest LiDAR place recognition, proposes Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC) to improve R@1, and introduces an efficient implementation.
tldr_zh: 本文诊断了森林LiDAR地点识别中Scan Context的失败原因，提出地形归一化垂直分布Scan Context (TNVD-SC)以提高R@1，并提出了高效实现。

title: Dynamics-Aligned Representation Learning under Induced Partial Observability
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has enabled sample-efficient learning of continuous control policies from high-dimensional observations through learned latent dynamics models. These models are typically trained with observation reconstruction objectives, which provide strong supervision but can bias representations toward visual fidelity leading to an undertrained prior and unreliable long-horizon predictions. We propose a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training by sampling a spatial binary mask from a Beta--Bernoulli random field and applying it to the raw observation. The gate probability is resampled at each time step, exposing the encoder to conditions ranging from near-total occlusion to near-full visibility. Integration of our method requires minimal architectural changes from existing dynamics models: the gated observation and the binary mask are channel-wise concatenated and passed to the encoder as a single augmented input, with no modifications to the broader training pipeline. We evaluate the proposed approach on a set of pixel-based continuous control tasks selected from the DeepMind Control Suite. Using model predictive control for evaluation, which relies solely on open-loop model rollouts, we show that stochastic gating improves planning performance and data efficiency across tasks. Further analysis demonstrates that performance is robust to the spatial scale of the mask, and a balanced observability during training outperforms configurations biased toward either sparser or denser observations.
tldr: This paper introduces a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training of latent dynamics models, improving planning performance and data efficiency on pixel-based continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种随机门控机制，在训练潜动力学模型时引入受控的部分可观测性，提高了基于像素的连续控制任务的规划性能和样本效率。

title: EgoRayFormer: Ray-Space Stereo Refinement for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Head-mounted stereo fisheye cameras provide a compact view of the wearer's body, but strong distortion, partial visibility and a short baseline make 3D pose estimation difficult. Existing refinement decoders sample image features independently in each view, without requiring the samples to correspond to a common 3D hypothesis. We introduce EgoRayFormer, a causal pose estimator that couples stereo feature sampling and geometric refinement in ray space. For each joint, the decoder projects shared 3D hypotheses along and around its viewing ray into both images. A geometric branch then corrects the projected joint locations and intersects the resulting rays; a learned gate blends this geometric estimate with a learned pose update. This formulation introduces an explicit stereo constraint while retaining flexibility when the rays provide weak depth constraints. In local evaluations on the official device-relative test splits, EgoRayFormer achieves three-seed mean MPJPEs of 17.64 mm on UnrealEgo2 and 49.55 mm on UnrealEgo-RW, improving to 47.57 mm with UnrealEgo2 pre-training. In paired validation ablations, removing the geometric branch increases MPJPE in all three seeds at both input resolutions. With a common ResNet-18 encoder and input resolution, our system reduces RW test MPJPE by 9.09 mm relative to the device-relative EgoPoseFormer baseline. A separate protocol analysis quantifies the difference between device-relative and oracle-root evaluation.
tldr: EgoRayFormer introduces a causal stereo refinement decoder for egocentric 3D human pose estimation that couples feature sampling in ray space with geometric ray intersection, improving MPJPE on UnrealEgo benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EgoRayFormer 提出了一种用于第一人称视角3D人体姿态估计的因果立体细化解码器，在射线空间中结合特征采样与几何射线相交，在UnrealEgo基准上提升了MPJPE指标。

title: CAOS-SLAM: Class-Agnostic Object-Aware Real-Time vSLAM for Dynamic Environments
summary: Robust visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (vSLAM) in dynamic environments faces challenges due to the presence of moving objects that may introduce erroneous observations, corrupt the map reconstruction and overall degrade localization accuracy. Existing vSLAM approaches often rely on predefined semantic classes or costly pixel-wise classification, limiting their robustness or applicability in real-world scenarios. This paper presents CAOS-SLAM, a dynamic vSLAM framework that extends ORB-SLAM3 with a hybrid perception pipeline to detect, track, and filter both semantically known and previously unseen moving objects in real-time. On-demand panoptic segmentation is performed for object discovery, with candidate unknown objects instantiated through depth-based clustering of unclassified regions. Between panoptic updates, persistent object tracks are updated using lightweight detection when available or temporal mask propagation based on world-frame Kalman prediction, depth consistency, and appearance similarity. The estimated object motion is then used to reject dynamic features from the SLAM pipeline. Experimental results on multiple dynamic RGB-D datasets and real-world experiments demonstrate improved localization accuracy over state-of-the-art dynamic vSLAM approaches, achieving up to 59% lower localization error in scenes characterized by unknown dynamic objects and up to 88% lower error in heavily occluded scenes, while achieving a median processing rate of 30 FPS on a laptop. Furthermore, the tracking module provides estimates of object trajectories and velocities, supporting potential future applications in perception, navigation, and motion-planning tasks in dynamic environments. Code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: CAOS-SLAM enhances ORB-SLAM3 with a hybrid perception pipeline that detects, tracks, and filters both known and unknown moving objects in real-time, improving localization accuracy in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: CAOS-SLAM 通过混合感知流程扩展 ORB-SLAM3，实时检测、跟踪和过滤已知及未知运动物体，提高动态环境中的定位精度。

title: AnchorFlow-VIO: Fixed-Template Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry on LaMAria
summary: We present AnchorFlow-VIO, an open-source Basalt-derived monocular visual-inertial odometry system, and evaluate a uniform configuration on LaMAria. The system uses one grayscale camera and one IMU, combining factory IMU correction, a fixed timing adjustment, windowed initialization and fixed-template patch tracking. Server evaluation of all 63 test recordings yields control-point scores of 47.2, 37.1, 24.8, 35.1 and 15.6 for Short, Medium, Long, Low light and Moving platform. Test pose recalls at 5 m are 84.6%, 69.1%, 53.9% and 62.9% for the four categories reporting dense recall. On ten training recordings, mean control-point score is 41.38 and all 265,694 image timestamps receive poses, including 204 filled poses. One training platform recording diverges and scores zero. A paired four-record comparison favors fixed over rolling templates on three recordings, while reversing that ranking on the fourth. Increasing feature density also yields mixed results. Ten fresh runs at prospectively fixed 30 s and 120 s offsets expose substantial start sensitivity: a low-light recording scores 6.14 at the earlier start and 42.00 at the later start. These results characterize the limits of the frozen system and show why complete output, feature counts and selected successful runs are insufficient evidence of robust localization. Source code, frozen configuration and reproducible submission tools are publicly available; training ablations are reported separately from the submitted test evaluation.
tldr: This paper presents AnchorFlow-VIO, an open-source Basalt-derived monocular visual-inertial odometry system, and evaluates its uniform configuration and performance limits on the LaMAria benchmark, highlighting the insufficiency of complete output and selected runs for proving robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AnchorFlow-VIO，一个基于Basalt的开源单目视觉惯性里程计系统，并在LaMAria基准上评估其统一配置和性能极限，指出完整输出和选定运行不足以证明鲁棒性。

title: A GPU-Resident Pipeline for Multi-Robot 3D Inspection with Limited Perception
summary: We present a complete, GPU-resident pipeline for multi-robot 3D inspection of underwater structures. Given a triangle mesh and a fleet of $K$ robots, each carrying a short-range, limited field-of-view camera, the pipeline computes 6-DOF trajectories that jointly cover a target fraction of the surface while minimizing a linearly interpolated makespan/total-cost objective. The joint problem is NP-hard, so we decompose it into five core stages - candidate viewpoint generation, visibility computation, set cover, min-max vehicle routing solved as a mixed integer program (MIP) with lifted Miller-Tucker-Zemlin subtour elimination, and priority-based multi-agent path finding with continuous-time inter-robot conflict checking - flanked by mesh loading and surface sampling as preprocessing and by trajectory smoothing as postprocessing. Our contributions are: an end-to-end GPU-accelerated integration of the five stages, with its kernel design documented; a GPU batch adaptation of Lien's $\varepsilon$-visibility with four custom CUDA kernels; a $β$-aware per-vehicle tour upper bound derived from the interpolated objective, supplementing the Desrochers-Laporte coefficient lift with forbidden-pair cuts; a 4D space-time extension of Zhou and Zeng's GPU parallel-frontier A*; and an experimental evaluation on 14 meshes (up to $7.2$M faces) that ablates the routing cuts and the parallel-frontier search, audits collision freedom and waypoint attainment \emph{after} trajectory smoothing, and measures the end-to-end gap against analytical and LP-relaxation lower bounds. Code and raw results are publicly available.
tldr: This paper presents a complete GPU-resident pipeline for multi-robot 3D inspection of underwater structures, integrating viewpoint generation, visibility computation, set cover, min-max routing, and multi-agent path finding, with experiments on large meshes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个完整的GPU驻留管线，用于水下结构的多机器人3D检查，集成了视点生成、可见性计算、集合覆盖、最小最大路由和多智能体路径规划，并在大型网格上进行了实验。

title: Curvature as a Baseline: Monocular Pose Measurement of Cylindrical Objects with Dual Colour Stripe Markers
summary: Thin cylindrical objects offer little space for planar markers. We propose a dual-colour-stripe marker that uses the known curvature of an object to improve pose measurement with a single camera. The boundary between two colours provides a long centre line, while dots and printed edges supply features at different depths. We analyse how this depth separation improves the estimation of rotation about the cylinder axis, or roll. For a camera-facing marker at 15 cm, the Cramér-Rao lower bound on roll standard deviation is 2.00°for a flat marker, 0.38°for a single curved marker and 0.21°for a wrap-around marker. Monte Carlo roll RMS errors are within about 10% of the corresponding standard-deviation bounds. A first-order relation connects the sagitta of the curved marker to the roll sensitivity provided by a stereo baseline. The analytical and simulation results explain how curvature improves monocular measurement and provide a basis for designing marker geometry.
tldr: This paper proposes a dual-colour-stripe marker that leverages the known curvature of thin cylindrical objects to improve monocular pose measurement, particularly roll estimation, with analytical and simulation validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双色条纹标记，利用细圆柱物体的已知曲率来改进单目位姿测量，尤其是滚转角的估计，并进行了分析和仿真验证。

title: Policy Search in Code Space for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Developing coordination policies for complex multi-agent systems relies on either labor-intensive algorithm design or opaque task-specific reinforcement learning. With recent advances in autonomous coding agents, we show that policy search directly in code space offers a compelling third path that combines automated optimization with explicit interpretability. We investigate a human-directed workflow in which coding agents iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, diagnose, and eventually refine algorithms guided by simulation feedback and explicit correctness verification. We conducted two case studies and found that this workflow robustly outperformed any manually engineered solutions. On a challenging map in the 2024 League of Robot Runners competition, a two-day search discovered a policy that exceeds the stronger locally reproduced competition entry by 35.0% on the densest instance and generalizes to unseen map instances. In simulated real-world warehouses with irregular lanes, continuous robot geometry, and asynchronous motion, a week-long search discovered an entirely new class of multi-agent pathfinding algorithm that outperforms a calibrated proprietary solution in throughput by 58.9%. Under stated assumptions, we further prove that the new algorithm is collision-free and completes, in finite time, every accepted goal that is not withdrawn or replaced. Together, the studies show that policy search in code space powered by state-of-the-art coding agents offers a highly competitive path to building real engineering solutions that are both effective and analytically tractable.
tldr: This paper introduces a human-directed workflow where coding agents iteratively search over multi-agent pathfinding policies in code space, discovering algorithms that outperform manual and proprietary solutions in warehouse simulations and a competition map.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种由人类指导的工作流程，其中编码代理在代码空间中迭代搜索多智能体路径规划策略，在仓库模拟和比赛地图中发现了优于手动和专有解决方案的算法。

title: AeroIntent: A Synchronized Multimodal Benchmark for UAV Mission Intent Recognition
summary: Reliable recognition of mission-level UAV intent from multimodal observations is essential for low-altitude airspace surveillance and security. Existing multimodal UAV datasets primarily support detection, tracking, and localization, leaving limited support for evaluating mission-intent recognition across held-out trajectory programs and incomplete radar histories. We introduce AeroIntent, a simulation-based benchmark comprising 990 synchronized multimodal sequences generated by 22 trajectory programs across five mission intents. The benchmark provides radar, RGB, infrared, and depth observations, together with program-disjoint, radar-gap, and observation-prefix evaluation protocols. Building on this benchmark, we propose AeroMIR, a structured Multimodal Intent Reasoner that integrates radar trajectories, derived behavioral features, selected visual evidence, and task knowledge for candidate-based UAV intent recognition. Under a strict program-disjoint protocol evaluating unseen tactical realizations, AeroMIR achieves a mean accuracy of 71.56% and a mean Macro-F1 of 69.84% across three seeds, outperforming the strongest trajectory-only baseline by 7.79 Macro-F1 points and a conventional radar-RGB late-fusion baseline by 19.32 points. AeroMIR also demonstrates strong performance under controlled radar gaps and early intent recognition settings. AeroIntent and AeroMIR provide a reproducible foundation for multimodal UAV intent recognition. The benchmark is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AeroIntent
tldr: AeroIntent introduces a simulation-based multimodal UAV benchmark with radar, RGB, infrared, and depth sequences for mission intent recognition, along with a structured reasoner (AeroMIR) that outperforms baselines in unseen trajectory and radar-gap settings.
tldr_zh: AeroIntent 提出了一个基于仿真的多模态无人机基准，包含雷达、RGB、红外和深度序列，用于任务意图识别，并配套了一个结构化推理器 (AeroMIR)，在未见过轨迹和雷达缺失情况下超越基线。

title: Vehicle-State-Aware Confidence Estimation for Direct Wind Sensing on a Multirotor
summary: Direct wind sensing from a multi-rotor UAV enables localized atmospheric measurements, but the reliability of the anemometer depends on vehicle motion. This work presents a vehicle-state-aware confidence method that uses horizontal and vertical vehicle speed to quantify the acquisition of each wind observation. The resulting confidence score is used to adapt measurement influence to a two-dimensional vector estimator. Experiments were conducted during horizontal translation, vertical motion, and held-out autonomous waypoint flight. The proposed two-feature formulation achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.995, with 98.84% of translation observations identified as unreliable. The confidence-aware adaptation reduced median estimator gain during translation from 0.207 to 0.064 while retaining median gain of 0.151 during hover. The results show that vehicle state provides useful proprioceptive context for regulating the influence of direct airborne wind observations.
tldr: The paper proposes a vehicle-state-aware confidence method for direct wind sensing on a multirotor UAV, using horizontal and vertical speed to quantify observation reliability and adaptively weight a 2D wind vector estimator.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于飞行器状态感知的置信度方法，用于多旋翼无人机直接风感测，利用水平和垂直速度量化观测可靠性并自适应调整二维风矢量估计器的权重。

title: ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
summary: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.
tldr: ActTime is an action-conditioned world model for time series that predicts outcomes under different actions using latent states and transitions, trained on factual data, and evaluated in domains like building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management.
tldr_zh: ActTime是一种针对时间序列的动作条件世界模型，通过潜状态和转换，在仅使用事实数据训练的情况下，预测不同动作下的结果，并在建筑能源、交通、温室气候和库存管理等领域进行了评估。

title: Foundation Model Driven Optical Flow
summary: We investigate how frozen pretrained visual and depth representations support dense optical flow when coupled with a supervised matching network. Building on TTSFlow, this paper studies Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) feature decoding and one coarse-to-fine refinement stage. Our method fuses features from frozen DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 models and estimates optical flow through a trainable transformer-based matching pipeline. After optical-flow training on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings3D, it achieves 2.37 endpoint error (EPE) on the Sintel training split, Final pass, compared with 2.52 for the FlowSeek (T) configuration reported here. Our RoCo-Spring 2026 entry, RoCo-29.VSAI, obtains a robustness-balanced score of 1.1038, Spring EPE of 1.411, and RobustSpring proxy EPE of 4.739, with a lower balanced score than seven of the twelve listed reference baselines. These results characterize the complete pipeline, which reuses frozen foundation backbones and performs one refinement stage. Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}
tldr: This paper explores using frozen pretrained visual and depth foundation model features (DINOv2, Depth Anything V2) combined with a trainable transformer-based matching network for dense optical flow estimation, achieving competitive EPE on Sintel and reporting a RoCo-Spring 2026 benchmark entry. It focuses on improving optical flow through frozen feature fusion and a single refinement stage.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了利用冻结的预训练视觉和深度基础模型特征（DINOv2、Depth Anything V2）结合可训练的基于Transformer的匹配网络进行密集光流估计，在Sintel上取得了有竞争力的EPE，并报告了RoCo-Spring 2026基准测试的成绩。其重点是通过冻结特征融合和单次细化阶段来提升光流性能。

title: Reconstruction and Discrete-Event Simulation Assessment of an Analytical
summary: This article presents an analytical-DES benchmark for intra-aisle robotic picking in automated warehousing. The investigated cycle combines horizontal shuttle travel, tote handling and item picking at storage locations. Simulation results are compared with the analytical formulation of Lerher et al. under the same rack geometry, shuttle-motion, handling and picking conditions, and the same definitions of cycle time and derived item throughput. Reproducing the published analytical tables requires the distance interpretation dES = 1.5 m and dTB = 0 m. The analytical-DES benchmark comprises 180 scenarios formed from three rack lengths, two paired motion profiles and n = 1 to 30 visited picking locations, with ten simulation replications per scenario. The six n = 1 cases are reported separately because no travel-between component is present. Across the remaining 174 scenarios, the mean absolute relative cycle-time discrepancy is 0.8655%, the median is 0.6758%, and the maximum is 7.0370%. The mean absolute error is 2.411 s and the RMSE is 2.744 s. The simulated scenario-mean cycle time is below the analytical value in all 174 principal scenarios. The results therefore show close numerical correspondence under the tested conditions, but not exact agreement, formal statistical equivalence, or validation against an operating warehouse.
tldr: This paper presents an analytical-discrete-event simulation benchmark for intra-aisle robotic picking in automated warehousing, comparing simulation results to published analytical formulations and reporting close numerical correspondence across 180 scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于自动化仓库通道内机器人拣选的解析-离散事件仿真基准，比较仿真结果与已发表解析公式，并在180个场景中报告了接近的数值一致性。

title: Enhancing Lunar PNT Performance Through Surface Station Enabled Radiometric Observables
summary: Future lunar surface missions require reliable positioning for autonomous rover operations. Lunar navigation satellite systems may provide limited vertical positioning accuracy due to satellite availability and observation geometry, particularly during early deployment. This study investigates a radiometric navigation architecture in which a lunar surface station (SS) improves rover positioning through double-differenced satellite observations and additional surface-to-surface ranging. Pseudorange and Doppler measurements from lunar navigation satellites are used for relative positioning between the SS and rover, while dual one-way ranging (DOWR) provides an additional range observable. The radiometric solution is integrated with rover dead-reckoning information. Monte Carlo simulations were conducted using five satellites representative of NASA's Lunar Communications Relay and Navigation Systems (LCRNS) constellation and a rover trajectory near Connecting Ridge at the lunar south pole. The results show that the SS improves horizontal and vertical relative positioning, with further gains from DOWR. In the simulated scenario, the mean 99.7% vertical positioning error decreased from 29.9 m without the SS to 5.5 m with double-differenced pseudorange and Doppler processing, and to 4.8 m with DOWR. An uncorrected DOWR hardware bias significantly degraded positioning, whereas the proposed bias-estimation method achieved a final estimation error of 0.058 +/- 0.057 m. The benefit of DOWR also depended on observation geometry. These results demonstrate the potential of a lunar surface station to improve vertical relative positioning through direct radiometric ranging, complementing its communication and navigation support roles.
tldr: This paper proposes a lunar surface station that provides radiometric observables (double-differenced pseudorange/Doppler and dual one-way ranging) to improve rover relative positioning, achieving a significant reduction in vertical positioning error in Monte Carlo simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出利用月球表面站提供的无线电测量观测值（双差伪距/多普勒和双单向测距）来改善月球车相对定位，蒙特卡洛模拟显示垂直定位误差显著降低。

title: 3D Diffusion Models for Medical Imaging
summary: Generative deep learning methods such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks or Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in image synthesis. In particular, Diffusion Models have demonstrated superior image fidelity and sample diversity compared to other approaches on standard benchmarks, while also offering more flexible training dynamics as evidenced both in natural image domains and in medical applications. In medical imaging including Computed Tomography, Magnetic Resonance Imaging or Positron Emission Tomography, such models have various important use-cases including data augmentation, domain transfer, image reconstruction, inpainting, image augmentation and artifact correction. Further, generated images can be conditioned on patient characteristics, medical reports, segmentation masks or other images. Specific challenges arise due to the 3D volumetric nature of medical images, which translate to substantial demands in terms of memory, compute, and training data. This article provides a comparative overview of 3D Diffusion Models which have been developed for medical images, with a focus on current performance, limitations, and an outlook for future work.

title: 3D-MoE: Complementarity-Guided Hardware-Software Co-Design for MoE Decode on 3D-Stacked NMP
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have become a mainstream way to scale Large Language Models (LLMs), because each token activates only a small subset of experts, reducing inference cost. However, MoE decode remains highly memory-bound and exhibits strongly skewed, time-varying expert loads. 3D-stacked DRAM near-memory processing (NMP) provides the bandwidth that decode demands, yet its tiled organization makes load balancing expensive: expert parallelism (EP) preserves locality but suffers from hotspot-induced imbalance, while more distributed strategies weaken locality and increase NoC traffic.
  To address this locality-balance conflict, we observe that domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps, a property we call expert complementarity. Using this insight, we propose 3D-MoE, a hardware--software co-designed system for MoE decode on 3D-stacked NMP. 3D-MoE uses offline, one-time complementarity-guided grouping and locality-aware mapping to establish coarse-grained inter-group balance, handles residual intra-group hotspots through a lightweight Collaborative Memory-Network (CMN) that streams each hot expert's weight tiles once from its host DRAM channel to helper cores over a reconfigured local broadcast path, and uses cost-aware online remapping to remain robust to workload drift. Across MoE models, 3D-MoE achieves an average 4.63$\times$ MoE-layer speedup over EP and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.58$\times$--1.86$\times$ over the strongest NMP baselines, with 2.11\% additional logic-die area.

title: A "feature ODE" describing the learning behavior of shallow MLPs on simple functions
summary: We study the gradient flow training dynamics of two-layer multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on anisotropic Gaussian data. Even in this simple setting, solving the dynamics in full is notoriously difficult, so we try something different. We propose a "feature ODE" that might be intuitively expected to describe the learning dynamics of a shallow MLP. We find that MLPs trained to learn simple target functions (low-order Hermite polynomials and staircase functions) actually roughly follow the loss trajectories from this feature ODE. This agreement is a surprise because of the size of the simplification and the fact that it does not come from a rigorous chain of approximations. We discuss this surprise and speculate on its reasons and uses.

title: A Calibrated Instrument for Detecting Disposition Drift in Language Models
summary: Before language models are released, they are tested for harmful traits such as willingness to carry out dangerous requests, deception, power seeking, and sycophancy. The safe behavior these tests certify may degrade as models are modified, by topical fine-tuning, new training data, or changes to settings such as the depth of their reasoning. Most work reports such drift as single summary rates scored by another AI model, without the error analysis needed to interpret them. We adapt a calibrated measurement methodology recently developed for assessing how inference optimizations affect the quality of model outputs. Applying it to several misalignment dimensions in two open-weight models, we first establish the instrument's precision, showing that shifts of a few percentage points can be reliably detected. We then induce drift deliberately by fine-tuning on correct and on subtly harmful medical and financial advice; harmful advice induces a far greater shift than correct advice. Most strikingly, a model that reasons before answering can conceal the shift almost entirely in its answers, even though a direct reading of its internal state shows that its disposition has moved. With reasoning switched off, the same model shifts steadily as the share of harmful advice in its training grows. These results demonstrate the importance of testing safety with reasoning turned both on and off.

title: A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers
summary: Large language models are increasingly asked to shop on a user's behalf, which lets seller-controlled content such as badges, endorsements, and framing steer what they recommend. That poses the question at the core of generative engine optimization (GEO): not whether seller content shifts an agent's choice, but how much. The usual gauge of that influence, how often a cue wins the choice, has a blind spot: once a cue is strong enough to be picked almost every time, the choice rate can no longer show how much stronger one cue is than another. We introduce price-equivalent (PE) auditing, which removes this ceiling by pricing the cue in money. In a counterbalanced, position-controlled forced choice, we raise the cued product's price until it is chosen only half the time, and report that premium as the cue's price-equivalent: a formally defined, policy-conditioned parity threshold that makes very different cues comparable. Priced this way, cues that look equally strong at equal price differ by a wide margin, so choice-rate audits substantially under-resolve seller influence. We run the audit over 113,472 trials, seven models across families, and two product categories. To our knowledge, we also run the first price-equivalent audit of a decision-native model, Jev, which outputs a choice probability directly instead of generating text; strikingly, its profile is unlike any text model we tested, resisting most cues yet remaining susceptible to the strongest social-proof claims. We release the stimuli, logs, and code as a benchmark that reports each model's cue-price profile rather than a single score, giving developers and auditors a common, reproducible way to measure how content moves AI shopping agents.

title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

title: A Flexible ROI Analysis Tool for Spatially Consistent Vegetation Index Extraction from Turfgrass Imagery
summary: Time-series multispectral imaging is widely used to assess turfgrass condition; however, extracting plot-level vegetation index (VI) values remains labor-intensive when camera positions vary between acquisitions and automated plot tracking is unreliable. We developed an open-source software tool comprising (i) a graphical user interface (GUI) for the interactive placement of orientation-adjustable regions of interest (ROIs) with $N$-way subdivision to match plot geometry and (ii) a batch-processing script that computes plot-level mean VI values from single-band floating-point rasters and exports measurements and ROI coordinates in JSON format for reuse. Saved coordinates can be reapplied to measure NDVI, NDRE, and SAVI from identical pixel regions within a single time point without re-delineating ROIs. In a demonstration using rail-mounted multispectral turfgrass imagery (18 images), plot-level mean values were extracted in a single session, with coordinates reused directly for NDRE and SAVI rasters. The system reads non-georeferenced pixel-coordinate rasters natively, does not require GIS expertise, and supports reproducible VI quantification where static sensor deployment is impractical.

title: A Generic On-Board AI Processing Chain for Earth Observation: From Application Development to Embedded Deployment and Mission-Level Orchestration
summary: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

title: A New Hope for PRNU on Modern Smartphones? Evidence That Device-Specific Fingerprints Survive Computational Photography
summary: Photo Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is widely regarded as the most reliable marker for source camera identification. Recent studies, however, report high correlations between images and fingerprints from different modern smartphones, which calls into question the discriminative power of PRNU on these devices. Using 30 recent smartphones under controlled acquisition conditions (e.g., no digital zoom), we investigate whether the fingerprint itself is at fault or the way it is compared. We find that a component shared by all fingerprints of the same model inflates the standard signed peak-to-correlation energy (sPCE). To counter this, we propose $Δ$sPCE: the sPCE between a query image and a candidate camera's fingerprint, minus the mean sPCE between that image and the fingerprints of the remaining candidates, in the spirit of T-norm score normalization. $Δ$sPCE improves attribution accuracy, suggesting that the device-specific PRNU signal is still present. Although the limited dataset size and the dependence of $Δ$sPCE on the candidate camera set currently restrict operational applicability, these results suggest that PRNU-based attribution of modern smartphones remains feasible when fingerprints are compared appropriately.

title: A Pitfall in the Evaluation of Gene Perturbation Models
summary: Gene perturbation models aim to predict transcriptional responses to unseen genetic interventions, but comparisons rely on heterogeneous evaluation metrics and differentially-expressed (DE) gene subsets. We investigate the consequences of these choices using eight methods across six single-gene perturbation datasets under a unified evaluation protocol. Varying the number of top DE genes reveals substantial instability in Precision-based rankings, with the winning method changing $86.7\%$ of the time, while rankings based on the rest of the metrics remain comparatively stable. Investigating this discrepancy exposes that repeating a single predicted expression profile across cell-level rows, a standard practice for many methods, can inflate significance estimates and produce excessively large predicted significant-DE sets. Specifically we found that $67.1\%$ of tested perturbation--gene pairs pass the significance threshold despite some of them having minuscule effects. We derive an inflation factor showing that replicated predictions can amplify the standardized Mann--Whitney statistic even after correction for tied ranks, without adding independent information. This artifact changes Precision mainly as the number of DE genes increases because for smaller cutoffs, most of the genes are already significant due to the effect-based ordering. Taking this pitfall into account in our benchmark comparison, we find that a random forest using Gene Ontology features achieves the best overall results.

title: A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection
summary: This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality.
